a45babf4c08c.en: Chapter two. False dependences, and renaming.
a45babf4c08c.zh: 第二章。假依赖与重命名。

729bae0cc384.en: Each instruction passes through four steps, and the scoreboard checks one kind of hazard at each. <bookmark mark='a'/> Issue happens in program order. An instruction issues when its kind of unit is free, and when no instruction already in flight is going to write the same register; that is the write after write hazard, and the 6600 simply refuses to have two writers of one name. <bookmark mark='b'/> Next, read operands. The instruction waits at its unit until every register it reads has been written by whoever was producing it: the true dependence. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then it executes, taking as many cycles as its unit needs. <bookmark mark='d'/> Last, write result. Before overwriting its destination, it waits until every earlier instruction that still needs the old value has read it: the write after read hazard. <bookmark mark='e'/> Notice that values travel only through the registers. Every hazard is a wait; nothing is renamed.
729bae0cc384.zh: 每条指令经过四步，记分牌在每一步检查一种冒险。<bookmark mark='a'/>发射按程序顺序进行。当一条指令所需种类的部件空闲，而且没有在途的指令将要写同一个寄存器时，它才发射；这就是写后写冒险，6600 干脆不允许同一个名字同时有两个写者。<bookmark mark='b'/>接着是读操作数。指令在它的部件前等着，直到它读的每个寄存器都已被产生它的指令写好：真依赖。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后它执行，部件需要几个周期就花几个周期。<bookmark mark='d'/>最后是写结果。在覆盖目的寄存器之前，它要等每条还需要旧值的更早的指令都读完：读后写冒险。<bookmark mark='e'/>注意，值只通过寄存器传递。每种冒险都是一次等待；没有任何东西被重命名。

898946206c1a.en: Here is the standard example from Hennessy and Patterson's textbook, written in Pebble's registers, with their latencies: a load takes one cycle, an add two, a multiply ten, a divide forty. <bookmark mark='a'/> Watch the scoreboard fill in the cycle at which each instruction completes each step. The first load issues in cycle one, reads in two, executes in three, writes in four. <bookmark mark='b'/> The second load cannot even issue until cycle five: there is only one integer unit, and the first load holds it until its result is written. <bookmark mark='c'/> The multiply and the subtract both wait for the second load, then read their operands together in cycle nine. The divide needs the multiply's result, so it waits at its unit until cycle twenty-one. <bookmark mark='d'/> And the last add. It issues in thirteen, when the adder is free, and its result is ready by sixteen. But it writes a1, and the divide, an earlier instruction, has not yet read the old a1. So the add sits on its finished result until cycle twenty-two. <bookmark mark='e'/> The whole thing takes sixty-two cycles.
898946206c1a.zh: 这是轩尼诗和帕特森教科书里的标准例子，用 Pebble 的寄存器写出，采用他们的延迟：取数一个周期，加法两个，乘法十个，除法四十个。<bookmark mark='a'/>看记分牌填出每条指令完成每一步的周期。第一条取数在第一周期发射，第二周期读操作数，第三周期执行，第四周期写回。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二条取数直到第五周期才能发射：只有一个整数部件，第一条取数一直占着它，直到结果写完。<bookmark mark='c'/>乘法和减法都在等第二条取数，然后在第九周期一起读操作数。除法需要乘法的结果，所以在它的部件前一直等到第二十一周期。<bookmark mark='d'/>还有最后的加法。它在第十三周期加法器空出时发射，结果在第十六周期就算好了。但它要写 a1，而更早的除法还没有读旧的 a1。于是加法守着算好的结果，一直等到第二十二周期。<bookmark mark='e'/>整段一共六十二个周期。

bb5446a0fd84.en: In 1967 IBM shipped the System/360 Model 91, a machine built for scientific computing. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its floating-point unit had a problem far worse than Pebble's: only four floating-point registers in the instruction set, so the same few names were reused constantly, and a scoreboard would have stalled on false dependences all the time. <bookmark mark='b'/> Robert Tomasulo's answer was to stop naming values by registers at all. A value in flight is named by the reservation station, a small waiting area in front of a functional unit, of the instruction that will produce it. <bookmark mark='c'/> An instruction waiting in a station holds, for each operand, either the value itself or the tag of the station that will produce it. <bookmark mark='d'/> And when a unit finishes, it broadcasts the result and its tag on a common data bus. Every station and the register file listen, and whoever is waiting for that tag takes the value. This is register renaming, done in 1967 with a handful of tags.
bb5446a0fd84.zh: 1967 年，IBM 交付了 System/360 Model 91，一台为科学计算而造的机器。<bookmark mark='a'/>它的浮点部件有一个比 Pebble 糟糕得多的问题：指令集里只有四个浮点寄存器，同样几个名字被不断重用，记分牌会一直卡在假依赖上。<bookmark mark='b'/>罗伯特·托马苏洛的答案是干脆不再用寄存器给值命名。一个在途的值，用将要产生它的那条指令所在的保留站来命名；保留站是功能部件前面一个小小的等候区。<bookmark mark='c'/>在保留站里等待的指令，对每个操作数要么持有值本身，要么持有将要产生它的保留站的标签。<bookmark mark='d'/>部件完成时，把结果和它的标签广播到一条公共数据总线上。每个保留站和寄存器堆都在听，谁在等这个标签，谁就把值取走。这就是寄存器重命名，1967 年就用一把标签做到了。

0f643d3960c0.en: Here is the machine. On the left, the instructions waiting to issue, in order. In the middle, the reservation stations: three for loads, three in front of the adder, two in front of the multiplier and divider. Below them the units, and under everything the common data bus, which runs back to every station and to the registers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Cycle one: the first load issues into Load1, and the register a1 now records that its next value will come from Load1. Cycle two: the second load issues, and a2 points at Load2. <bookmark mark='b'/> Cycle three: the multiply issues. Its operand a2 is not ready, so the station takes the tag Load2 instead. And the first load broadcasts: tag Load1 and its value go out on the bus, and a1 takes it. <bookmark mark='c'/> Cycle four: Load2 broadcasts, and the multiply, which was waiting for that tag, captures the value. The subtract issues with both its values in hand. <bookmark mark='d'/> Cycle five: the divide issues, waiting on tag Mult1, and holding the current value of a1. Cycle six: the last add issues. It will write a1, so a1 now points at Add2, but the divide does not care: it has already copied the old a1. That is the write after read hazard, gone. <bookmark mark='e'/> The subtract broadcasts in cycle seven, the add starts in the next cycle, and it broadcasts in cycle ten, while the multiply is still working. <bookmark mark='f'/> The multiply finishes in fifteen and its broadcast wakes the divide, which takes forty cycles and broadcasts in fifty-six.
0f643d3960c0.zh: 这就是这台机器。左边是等待发射的指令，按顺序排着。中间是保留站：三个给取数，三个在加法器前，两个在乘除法器前。下面是功能部件，最底下是公共数据总线，它通回每个保留站和寄存器。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一周期：第一条取数发射进 Load1，寄存器 a1 记下它的下一个值将来自 Load1。第二周期：第二条取数发射，a2 指向 Load2。<bookmark mark='b'/>第三周期：乘法发射。它的操作数 a2 还没好，所以保留站记下标签 Load2。同时第一条取数广播：标签 Load1 和它的值出现在总线上，a1 把它取走。<bookmark mark='c'/>第四周期：Load2 广播，一直在等这个标签的乘法捕获了这个值。减法发射，两个值都已在手。<bookmark mark='d'/>第五周期：除法发射，等着标签 Mult1，并持有 a1 的当前值。第六周期：最后的加法发射。它会写 a1，所以 a1 现在指向 Add2，但除法不在乎：它已经抄下了旧的 a1。这就是读后写冒险，消失了。<bookmark mark='e'/>减法在第七周期广播，加法在下一个周期开始，并在第十周期广播，那时乘法还在算。<bookmark mark='f'/>乘法在第十五周期完成，它的广播唤醒了除法，除法花四十个周期，在第五十六周期广播。

e0dfd84bbf48.en: Side by side. <bookmark mark='a'/> Most results arrive a little earlier, because the bus hands a value straight to the stations waiting for it, with no write and read through the register file. <bookmark mark='b'/> And the last add finishes twelve cycles sooner: under Tomasulo nobody waits for an earlier reader, because every reader has already copied what it needs. <bookmark mark='c'/> Fifty-six cycles instead of sixty-two. The divide's forty cycles dominate both, as they should: that is this example's critical path.
e0dfd84bbf48.zh: 并排对比。<bookmark mark='a'/>大多数结果都早到一点，因为总线把值直接交给等着它的保留站，不用经过寄存器堆写一次再读一次。<bookmark mark='b'/>最后的加法早了十二个周期完成：在托马苏洛算法下，没有谁要等更早的读者，因为每个读者都已经抄下了它需要的东西。<bookmark mark='c'/>五十六个周期而不是六十二个。除法的四十个周期在两者中都占主导，这理所当然：那是这个例子的关键路径。

9f88051c154a.en: Start with a short program on this part's functional core, constrained to a one-entry issue queue. That forces instructions to start in program order. Rows are instructions; time runs to the right. <bookmark mark='a'/> The fifth instruction loads from a cold cache line. We assign a sixty-cycle miss latency in this model. <bookmark mark='b'/> The next add needs that value and must wait. <bookmark mark='c'/> Several later instructions do not depend on the missing value. They still have their own dependencies and resource requirements, but this in-order configuration cannot pass the waiting add. Their useful work is delayed behind it. <bookmark mark='d'/> This recorded run takes eighty-one cycles for sixteen instructions, including setup and halt. It illustrates head-of-line blocking under the model's chosen resources and timing.
9f88051c154a.zh: 先把一个短程序放到本部分的功能模型核上，把发射队列限制为一个表项。这迫使指令按程序顺序开始。每行一条指令，时间向右走。<bookmark mark='a'/>第五条指令从一个冷缓存行取数。模型为这次缺失指定六十个周期的延迟。<bookmark mark='b'/>紧接的加法需要这个值，只能等待。<bookmark mark='c'/>后面有几条指令不依赖这个缺失值。它们仍有自己的数据依赖和资源要求，但这个按序配置无法越过正在等待的加法，于是有用的工作被挡在后面。<bookmark mark='d'/>这次记录共用八十一个周期，执行十六条指令，包含初始化与停机。它展示的是所选资源和时序模型下的队首阻塞。

4d342f9a3955.en: Now use the normal issue queue and ready-instruction selection on the same functional core. <bookmark mark='a'/> An instruction can start when its operands, execution resources and ordering rules allow. The load still misses, and its dependent add still waits. Later independent work can overlap the miss, while dependencies among those later instructions remain. <bookmark mark='b'/> Completed results wait for in-order architectural retirement, shown in blue. When the load finishes, the waiting add executes and the core retires the completed work in order. <bookmark mark='c'/> This run takes seventy cycles instead of eighty-one. The comparison changes queue capacity and scheduling freedom; it does not make every later instruction immediately ready or reproduce every feature of a physical processor.
4d342f9a3955.zh: 现在让同一个功能模型核使用正常的发射队列，并选择就绪指令。<bookmark mark='a'/>只有操作数、执行资源和顺序规则都允许时，指令才能开始。取数仍会缺失，依赖它的加法仍会等待。后面独立的工作可以与缺失重叠，但这些后续指令彼此之间的依赖仍然存在。<bookmark mark='b'/>完成的结果等待按序成为体系结构状态，图中用蓝色表示。取数结束后，等待的加法执行，模型核依次提交已完成的工作。<bookmark mark='c'/>这次用了七十个周期，而不是八十一个。对比改变了队列容量与调度自由度；它没有让所有后续指令立刻就绪，也没有复现物理处理器的全部特征。

2f02e98f3de1.en: The Job's first chapter retires eight hundred twenty-seven thousand five hundred seventy-six instructions in each configuration. <bookmark mark='a'/> Part 7's functional pipeline used about a million cycles, or zero point eight three retired instructions per cycle. <bookmark mark='b'/> This part's core with a one-entry issue queue takes about one point zero six million cycles. Its front end and recovery rules differ from that pipeline. <bookmark mark='c'/> The normal sixty-four-entry queue permits ready work to pass blocked instructions. It finishes in four hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred eighty cycles, about one point eight nine retired instructions per cycle. <bookmark mark='d'/> The program and execution-unit configuration are shared between these last two runs. Queue capacity and the resulting scheduling opportunities change together. These are model cycle counts; a silicon frequency and hardware speedup have not been measured.
2f02e98f3de1.zh: 任务第一章在每个配置下都提交八十二万七千五百七十六条指令。<bookmark mark='a'/>第七部分的功能流水线大约用了一百万个周期，每周期提交零点八三条指令。<bookmark mark='b'/>本部分模型核把发射队列限制为一个表项时，约用一百零六万个周期。它的前端与恢复规则不同于那条流水线。<bookmark mark='c'/>正常的六十四项队列允许就绪工作越过被阻塞的指令，用四十三万七千五百八十个周期完成，平均每周期提交约一点八九条指令。<bookmark mark='d'/>后两个运行使用相同程序与执行部件配置，同时改变了队列容量及由此产生的调度机会。这些是模型周期数，并没有测量硅片频率或硬件加速比。

dba9d72133db.en: The reorder buffer can hold a hundred twenty-eight in-flight instructions. <bookmark mark='a'/> This plot shows one six-hundred-cycle sample from the Job run. <bookmark mark='b'/> Occupancy rises and falls as instructions arrive, retire or are squashed. Separately, the histogram over the whole run gives a mean of ten point seven entries and no cycle at the full capacity. The plotted sample and whole-run statistics have different scopes. <bookmark mark='c'/> Real implementations can hold much more: Intel's 2021 Golden Cove disclosure gives a five-hundred-twelve-entry reorder buffer. Its entries count implementation operations, so they are not automatically equivalent to our model's architectural instructions. We will investigate why larger windows can help some workloads and why this particular run uses so little of its buffer.
dba9d72133db.zh: 重排序缓冲区最多容纳一百二十八条在途指令。<bookmark mark='a'/>这张图截取任务运行中的六百个周期。<bookmark mark='b'/>指令进入、提交或被清除时，占用量随之升降。另一个覆盖完整运行的直方图给出平均十点七项，而且没有任何周期达到容量上限。图中的片段与全程统计范围不同。<bookmark mark='c'/>实际实现可能容纳更多：英特尔二零二一年公开的 Golden Cove 核有五百一十二项重排序缓冲区。实际表项计算的是实现内部操作，并不自动等价于模型中的体系结构指令。接下来要研究大窗口何时有用，以及为什么这次运行只用了很小一部分容量。

619e8d3ac021.en: Here is the route through this part. <bookmark mark='a'/> First, a dataflow model: how quickly a known execution trace can be scheduled under explicit latency and resource assumptions. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then historical scheduling mechanisms: the scoreboard, Tomasulo's algorithm, renaming and precise retirement, illustrated with functional models and finite emulator comparisons. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then branch speculation, which lets ready work run before earlier control decisions are resolved. <bookmark mark='d'/> A modeled Spectre bounds-check-bypass experiment will show how wrong-path loads can influence a simulated cache. It reads data in the model's shared memory, not host hardware secrets. <bookmark mark='e'/> Finally, measured model cycles on passages support the next fitted full-corpus projection in the Job ledger.
619e8d3ac021.zh: 本部分的路线如下。<bookmark mark='a'/>先建立数据流模型：在明确的延迟和资源假设下，已知执行轨迹能被安排得多快。<bookmark mark='b'/>再看历史上的调度机制：记分牌、托马苏洛算法、重命名与精确提交，用功能模型及有限的模拟器对照测试来说明。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后是分支推测：先前的控制决定尚未解决时，就绪工作也能先执行。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个模型化的幽灵越界检查绕过实验会展示错误路径上的取数如何影响模拟缓存。读取的是模型共享内存中的数据，不是宿主硬件里的秘密。<bookmark mark='e'/>最后，根据文本片段的实测模型周期，拟合任务账本中的下一项全语料预测。

a5de9bb7619b.en: This is Part 8 of Computer Science, Built, in Act Two, Making It Fast. <bookmark mark='a'/> We will connect a program's dataflow graph and weighted critical path to carefully scoped scheduling limits. We will separate true register dependencies from name hazards, then follow the scoreboard, Tomasulo's algorithm, renaming and the reorder buffer. We will distinguish execution from architectural retirement, and examine finite resources, prediction and memory ordering. The later chapters cover a simulated Spectre experiment, VLIW scheduling, RISC and CISC, an oracle multithreading study and the Job's projected corpus runtime.
a5de9bb7619b.zh: 这是《计算机科学，从零搭建》第八部分，属于第二幕“让它更快”。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们把程序的数据流图和带权关键路径，与明确限定模型的调度界限连接起来。先区分真正的寄存器数据依赖与名称冒险，再依次研究记分牌、托马苏洛算法、重命名和重排序缓冲区。我们会区分执行与体系结构提交，考察有限资源、预测和内存顺序。后面的章节还包括模拟的幽灵实验、超长指令字调度、精简与复杂指令集、先知式多线程研究，以及任务全语料运行时间的预测。

5326943c6215.en: This is the Job's table-scan fast path when an entry's length differs from the word being searched. Matching lengths need additional letter comparisons, and reaching the insertion point follows another path. <bookmark mark='a'/> The displayed path has six instructions: table-end test, length load, comparison, two increments and a jump. <bookmark mark='b'/> With warm correct direction and target prediction, Part 7's pipeline takes seven steady-state cycles per such trip, including a load-use bubble. <bookmark mark='c'/> Now hold this known path fixed. Give its instructions explicit latencies and ask how overlapping their true dependencies changes the schedule. This idealization assumes the future path and relevant memory information are already known.
5326943c6215.zh: 这是任务扫描词表时，条目长度与待查单词不同的快速路径。长度相同还要比较字母，到达插入位置也会走另一条路径。<bookmark mark='a'/>图中这条路径有六条指令：检查表尾、取出长度、比较、两次递增和一次跳转。<bookmark mark='b'/>方向与目标预测已经预热且正确时，第七部分的流水线每趟稳态需要七个周期，其中包含一次取数后使用的气泡。<bookmark mark='c'/>现在固定这条已知路径，为指令指定延迟，研究真正的数据依赖相互重叠后如何改变调度。这个理想化模型预先知道未来路径及相关内存信息。

0ec2fb9bdab3.en: Each node is an instruction. An arrow connects a value's producer to an instruction that uses it. These arrows describe register data dependencies for this fixed path; real execution also has memory, control, resource and exception constraints. <bookmark mark='a'/> Place four trips at their earliest starts with unlimited resources. Loads take two cycles and the other displayed operations take one. The jumps have no register predecessors in this oracle graph. <bookmark mark='b'/> A length load needs its entry address, and the comparison waits for that load. <bookmark mark='c'/> The next entry address comes from a one-cycle increment of the previous address. <bookmark mark='d'/> The highlighted longest weighted chain, ending at the last comparison, spans six cycles. Under these dependencies and latencies, no valid schedule finishes the four trips sooner. The corresponding single-start, in-order schedule takes twenty-eight cycles; this is a scoped schedule comparison.
0ec2fb9bdab3.zh: 每个节点是一条指令，箭头把值的产生者连到使用它的指令。这些箭头描述固定路径上的寄存器数据依赖；实际执行还受内存、控制、资源和异常规则限制。<bookmark mark='a'/>假设资源无限，把四趟循环放到最早开始的时刻。取数延迟两个周期，其余图中操作延迟一个周期。在这个先知图中，跳转没有寄存器前驱。<bookmark mark='b'/>取出长度需要条目地址，比较则等待取数。<bookmark mark='c'/>下个条目的地址由前一个地址经过一次单周期递增得到。<bookmark mark='d'/>高亮的最长带权链终止于最后一次比较，跨度为六个周期。在这些依赖与延迟下，合法调度无法更早完成四趟循环。对应的按序、每周期单次启动调度需要二十八个周期；这个对比仅适用于所述模型。

5d33e6e01342.en: In this ideal scheduler, width W limits how many operations may start each cycle. It does not limit how many earlier operations remain in flight, and execution units are otherwise unlimited. <bookmark mark='a'/> One start slot gives twenty-four cycles for twenty-four instructions, including jumps. <bookmark mark='b'/> Two slots give twelve cycles. <bookmark mark='c'/> Four give seven. <bookmark mark='d'/> Eight give six, reaching this graph's weighted critical path. These are the computed schedules for four fixed fast-path trips. <bookmark mark='e'/> Two immediate lower bounds apply: at least the instruction count divided by start width, rounded up, and at least the longest dependency chain. Real cores need additional front-end, unit, ordering and retirement constraints.
5d33e6e01342.zh: 在这个理想调度器里，宽度 W 限制每周期能启动多少个操作。它不限制之前启动的在途操作数量，其余执行资源假设无限。<bookmark mark='a'/>每周期一个启动槽时，二十四条指令连同跳转共需二十四个周期。<bookmark mark='b'/>两个槽需要十二个周期。<bookmark mark='c'/>四个槽需要七个周期。<bookmark mark='d'/>八个槽需要六个周期，达到这张图的带权关键路径。这些是固定四趟快速路径的计算结果。<bookmark mark='e'/>立刻可以得到两个下界：至少需要指令数除以启动宽度后向上取整的周期数，也至少需要最长依赖链的跨度。真实处理器还受前端、执行部件、顺序和提交规则限制。

abe056d66a6c.en: Keep the resource model explicit. N counts instructions, L is the longest latency-weighted path, and W is the number of starts permitted each cycle. <bookmark mark='a'/> Every schedule in this start-slot model needs at least the larger of ceiling N over W and L. <bookmark mark='b'/> Graham's classic list-scheduling result concerns nonpreemptive jobs occupying W processors. Its work is A, the sum of processing times, and a greedy schedule takes at most A over W plus one minus one over W times L. With two-cycle loads, A and the instruction count N differ. Do not substitute one for the other when changing resource models. <bookmark mark='c'/> Our four-trip schedules satisfy the displayed start-slot lower bounds; they have twenty-four instructions and a six-cycle span. <bookmark mark='d'/> Across many fixed fast-path trips, the address recurrence permits one trip per cycle in the unlimited-resource, perfect-path idealization: six instructions per cycle after startup. This is a model opportunity, not a guarantee for the whole table search.
abe056d66a6c.zh: 必须明确资源模型。N 是指令数，L 是按延迟加权的最长路径，W 是每周期允许的启动次数。<bookmark mark='a'/>在启动槽模型中，每个调度至少需要 N 除以 W 向上取整与 L 之中的较大值。<bookmark mark='b'/>格雷厄姆的经典列表调度结果讨论的是占用 W 个处理器的不可抢占任务。工作量 A 是处理时间之和，贪心调度的时间至多为 A 除以 W，加上一减 W 分之一再乘 L。存在两周期取数时，A 与指令数 N 不相同，不能在改变资源模型时混用。<bookmark mark='c'/>我们的四趟调度满足图中的启动槽下界：二十四条指令，关键路径跨度六个周期。<bookmark mark='d'/>对许多趟固定快速路径，地址递推在资源无限、路径完全已知的理想条件下允许每周期一趟，启动阶段后每周期六条指令。这是模型中的机会，不是整个词表搜索的性能保证。

a0fa5daef7d1.en: Count register uses over the Job's eight hundred twenty-seven thousand instructions. The counting convention matters. <bookmark mark='a'/> About nine hundred eighty-one thousand source-operand uses refer to an earlier writer; repeated operands count separately. <bookmark mark='b'/> The other bars count roughly four hundred fifty-seven thousand read-since-write reuse events, and about as many successive-writer events. They are not all possible pairs of dependent instructions. <bookmark mark='c'/> Pebble has fifteen writable architectural registers plus a constant zero register. Reusing those writable names creates anti and output hazards. Renaming separates live register versions, while genuine value dependencies and memory or control constraints remain.
a0fa5daef7d1.zh: 现在统计任务八十二万多条指令中的寄存器使用情况，统计约定很关键。<bookmark mark='a'/>约九十八万一千次源操作数使用指向先前的写入者；重复操作数分别计数。<bookmark mark='b'/>另外两条柱分别统计约四十五万七千次写入后曾被读取的名称重用事件，以及数量相近的连续写入事件。它们不是所有可能的指令依赖对。<bookmark mark='c'/>Pebble 有十五个可写的体系结构寄存器，另外还有常量零寄存器。重用可写名称会产生反依赖和输出冒险。重命名分开仍然存活的寄存器版本，但真正的值依赖、内存与控制约束仍然存在。

4c1b5bff59b5.en: Give each live destination version a separate physical name. <bookmark mark='a'/> A register alias table maps architectural names to their current physical versions. Source operands capture either an existing value or its producing version. <bookmark mark='b'/> Process instructions in order: look up sources first, allocate a fresh destination version, then update the mapping. Here the first load writes p twenty, and its add reads that version while writing p twenty-one. <bookmark mark='c'/> The later load writes p twenty-two. It cannot overwrite the earlier load's value, though its own address, memory and execution-resource constraints still apply. <bookmark mark='d'/> The displayed live versions have distinct names, removing register anti and output hazards. Physical registers are safely reclaimed and reused later; they are not unique forever. The two value chains can overlap when their remaining constraints permit.
4c1b5bff59b5.zh: 给每个仍然存活的目标版本一个独立物理名称。<bookmark mark='a'/>寄存器别名表把体系结构名称映射到当前物理版本。源操作数记录已有值，或记录将产生该值的版本。<bookmark mark='b'/>按序处理指令：先查找源，再分配新的目标版本，最后更新映射。这里第一次取数写入物理寄存器二十，加法读取这个版本并写入物理寄存器二十一。<bookmark mark='c'/>后一次取数写入物理寄存器二十二，不会覆盖前一次取数的值，但仍须遵守自己的地址、内存和执行资源约束。<bookmark mark='d'/>图中存活版本的名称各不相同，寄存器反依赖与输出冒险因而消失。物理寄存器之后会在安全回收时重新使用，并非永远只写一次。其余约束允许时，两条值链就能重叠执行。

bf252687d400.en: This comparison uses an offline scheduler of the complete recorded execution, not a functional processor. It knows future paths and memory word addresses, assumes the listed operation latencies, and has unlimited start width and lookahead. It also omits realistic device and I/O ordering. <bookmark mark='a'/> With separate register versions, that particular oracle schedule averages about two thousand four hundred instructions per modeled cycle. It can overlap work whose future inputs were supplied by the recorded trace. <bookmark mark='b'/> Adding the scheduler's register-name constraints reduces this to about three point seven. <bookmark mark='c'/> The ratio shows how strongly these artificial name constraints affect this oracle. It is not a feasible hardware speedup, a bound across algorithms, or a claim that real cores approach either number. Register renaming is widely used in high-performance out-of-order designs because it removes name hazards within finite resources.
bf252687d400.zh: 这个对比使用完整执行记录的离线调度器，不是功能处理器。它预先知道未来路径与内存字地址，采用列出的操作延迟，启动宽度和向前查看距离都无限，并且省略真实设备与输入输出的顺序要求。<bookmark mark='a'/>分开寄存器版本后，这个特定先知调度平均每个模型周期约执行两千四百条指令。轨迹已经提供未来输入，因此它能把相关工作提前重叠。<bookmark mark='b'/>加入调度器定义的寄存器名称约束后，结果降至约三点七。<bookmark mark='c'/>这个比值说明这些人为名称约束对该先知模型的影响，不是可实现的硬件加速比，不是跨算法的界限，也不是说真实处理器接近其中任何一个数字。高性能乱序设计广泛使用重命名，是为了在有限资源中消除名称冒险。

5750c42e58f6.en: The Control Data 6600, delivered in 1964, is a landmark in dynamic instruction scheduling, associated with Seymour Cray and James Thornton. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its ten functional units could overlap different operations, subject to dependencies and shared resources. <bookmark mark='b'/> The scoreboard tracked functional-unit availability, pending register writers and operand readiness. That bookkeeping let instructions execute out of order while protecting their register dependencies. <bookmark mark='c'/> The machine used a hundred-nanosecond clock. Historical peak floating-point rates and application throughput are different measures, so we will focus on its scheduling mechanism rather than a universal performance ranking. The important question is how several units cooperate without changing the program's results.
5750c42e58f6.zh: 一九六四年交付的控制数据公司六六零零，是动态指令调度的重要里程碑，与西摩·克雷和詹姆斯·桑顿联系在一起。<bookmark mark='a'/>它的十个功能部件能重叠处理不同操作，但仍受依赖和共享资源限制。<bookmark mark='b'/>记分牌记录功能部件是否可用、哪些指令准备写寄存器，以及操作数是否就绪。这些记录使指令能乱序执行，同时保护寄存器依赖。<bookmark mark='c'/>这台机器采用一百纳秒时钟。历史上的浮点峰值与应用吞吐量不是同一个指标，所以这里关注调度机制，而不作通用性能排名。关键问题是多个部件如何合作而不改变程序结果。

acf76c82b98d.en: This scoreboard handles several hazards by waiting. <bookmark mark='a'/> A pending writer blocks another writer of the same register, and an earlier reader can delay a later writeback. <bookmark mark='b'/> In this model, results reach their users through register writes and subsequent operand reads. <bookmark mark='c'/> Dispatch is in program order: if the next instruction cannot reserve its required unit, later instructions cannot dispatch past it. <bookmark mark='d'/> Tomasulo's algorithm adds reservation stations, producer tags and direct result broadcast. Those remove register-name hazards and decouple dispatch from immediate unit availability. Traditional Tomasulo still dispatches in order, and still stalls when the needed station is full. It does not remove every limit listed here.
acf76c82b98d.zh: 这个记分牌通过等待处理几类冒险。<bookmark mark='a'/>已有写入者会阻止另一个指令写同一寄存器，先前的读取者也可能延迟后面的写回。<bookmark mark='b'/>在这里的模型中，结果先写寄存器，使用者随后再读取操作数。<bookmark mark='c'/>派发按程序顺序进行：下一条指令无法预留所需部件时，后续指令不能越过它派发。<bookmark mark='d'/>托马苏洛算法加入保留站、产生者标签与直接结果广播，从而消除寄存器名称冒险，并让派发不必等待执行部件立即空闲。但传统托马苏洛仍按序派发，所需保留站满时仍会停顿，并没有消除这里列出的全部限制。

f7253a493207.en: Out-of-order writeback creates an exception problem if architectural results become visible immediately. <bookmark mark='a'/> In this teaching schedule, the younger add writes in cycle ten, before the older divide broadcasts in cycle fifty-six. <bookmark mark='b'/> Suppose our illustrative divide-zero policy reports a fault when the divide finishes. Pebble uses such a fault policy, unlike RISC-V M's defined integer divide-zero result. <bookmark mark='c'/> The younger add has already changed architectural state, so simply stopping cannot expose the state immediately before the divide. This is an imprecise exception. The historical Model 91 had imprecise floating-point interruptions; that is a separate ISA-specific behavior, not this integer example. Precise recovery has several possible implementations. Next we will separate execution from architectural retirement using a reorder buffer.
f7253a493207.zh: 如果乱序写回立即改变体系结构结果，就会产生异常处理问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>在这个教学时序中，较年轻的加法在第十周期写回，比第五十六周期才广播的较老除法更早。<bookmark mark='b'/>假设示例采用除零时报告故障的策略。Pebble 确实使用这种策略，而 RISC-V M 对整数除零定义了结果，不触发这种故障。<bookmark mark='c'/>较年轻的加法已经改变体系结构状态，所以直接停机无法给出除法执行前的状态，这就是不精确异常。历史上的 Model 91 存在不精确浮点中断，那是另一种与指令集有关的行为，不是这里的整数示例。精确恢复有多种实现方式。接下来用重排序缓冲区把执行与体系结构提交分开。

b0bd1ada9816.en: Smith and Pleszkun's 1985 work studied several ways to provide precise interrupts in pipelined processors. The reorder buffer is one important approach. <bookmark mark='a'/> Dispatch instructions in order, execute them when their operands, resources and ordering constraints permit, and retire architectural effects in program order. <bookmark mark='b'/> Execution results may already be in temporary storage or a physical register file, and dependent instructions may use them before retirement. Retirement makes the architectural result official; it is not necessarily the first physical write. <bookmark mark='c'/> A precise exception exposes a valid architectural prefix of the program, with the faulting instruction handled according to its specified policy. Cache and predictor effects require separate reasoning. Precise architectural state alone does not guarantee secrecy.
b0bd1ada9816.zh: 史密斯与普莱兹昆在一九八五年的研究讨论了流水线处理器实现精确中断的多种方案，重排序缓冲区是其中一个重要方法。<bookmark mark='a'/>按序派发指令，操作数、资源和顺序约束允许时执行，再按程序顺序提交体系结构效果。<bookmark mark='b'/>执行结果可能已经写入临时存储或物理寄存器文件，依赖它的指令也可能在提交前使用结果。提交让体系结构结果正式生效，不一定是第一次物理写入。<bookmark mark='c'/>精确异常给出程序的一个合法体系结构前缀，故障指令按规定策略处理。缓存和预测器效果需要另行分析，仅有精确体系结构状态并不保证秘密安全。

b677c9717885.en: We draw this reorder buffer as a ring of slots. <bookmark mark='a'/> The animation follows a short recorded scan-loop window. Up to four instructions are renamed into tail slots each cycle. Orange means waiting, green executing, and blue complete but waiting to retire. <bookmark mark='b'/> Up to four completed instructions retire from the head in order. A completed younger instruction cannot retire around an unfinished older one. <bookmark mark='c'/> A branch redirect discards its younger entries and restarts fetch. Their architectural destinations were never committed, but their execution was real within the model: loads may already have changed the simulated cache. The ring records retirement order; it does not erase every microarchitectural trace of squashed work.
b677c9717885.zh: 把这个重排序缓冲区画成一圈表项。<bookmark mark='a'/>动画对应一段记录下来的扫描循环。每周期最多四条指令重命名后进入尾部：橙色表示等待，绿色表示执行，蓝色表示完成但尚未提交。<bookmark mark='b'/>每周期最多四条已完成指令从头部按序提交。较年轻指令即使完成，也不能越过尚未完成的较老指令提交。<bookmark mark='c'/>分支重定向会丢弃后续表项并重新取指。它们的体系结构目标没有提交，但在模型中确实执行过工作，取数可能已经改变模拟缓存。这个环记录提交顺序，并不会擦除被清除工作的全部微体系结构痕迹。

de5b94292197.en: Here is Pebble's deliberate divide-zero fault policy. <bookmark mark='a'/> Division has a modeled sixteen-cycle latency. The fault is recorded with its instruction instead of being reported immediately. <bookmark mark='b'/> Younger operations can compute results, including a store's address and data. They wait behind the divide and cannot commit architectural effects. <bookmark mark='c'/> When the fault reaches the head, older instructions have retired, the faulting divide does not write a result, and younger instructions are discarded. Pebble stops and reports the fault; it does not implement an operating-system resume path. <bookmark mark='d'/> The older store has written eleven to memory. The younger store has not committed its write. That is precise architectural state under this policy. Remaining cache or predictor effects are a separate question, and RISC-V M defines a different result for integer division by zero.
de5b94292197.zh: 这里采用 Pebble 明确指定的除零故障策略。<bookmark mark='a'/>模型中的除法延迟十六个周期，故障随指令记录，不立即报告。<bookmark mark='b'/>较年轻的操作可以计算结果，包括存数地址和数据，但它们排在除法之后，不能提交体系结构效果。<bookmark mark='c'/>故障到达头部时，较老指令已提交，故障除法不写结果，较年轻指令被丢弃。Pebble 停机并报告故障，并没有实现操作系统恢复执行的路径。<bookmark mark='d'/>较老存数已把十一写入内存，较年轻存数则没有提交写入。这是在该策略下的精确体系结构状态。缓存或预测器残留效果是另一个问题，而 RISC-V M 对整数除零定义了不同结果。

5223fbc5f7d2.en: This diagram separates stages often found in out-of-order cores. <bookmark mark='a'/> Fetch follows a predicted path, decode identifies operations, and ordered rename and dispatch allocate tracking resources. Our width parameter limits fetch, rename and retirement to four per cycle. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ready operations compete for execution resources. This implementation can start up to six total operations in a cycle, with at most four ALU starts and two memory operations, plus its multiplier and divider restrictions. Width must therefore name a particular stage. <bookmark mark='c'/> Completed results wake dependents; architectural retirement remains ordered. Oldest-ready selection is our policy, not a requirement for every processor. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our model holds results in instruction records and copies register results at retirement. Other designs write speculative physical registers earlier and commit mappings later. Their reorder buffers track more than just pointers: completion, exception and recovery metadata also matter.
5223fbc5f7d2.zh: 这张图分开了乱序核中常见的几个阶段。<bookmark mark='a'/>取指沿预测路径前进，译码识别操作，按序重命名与派发分配跟踪资源。这里的宽度参数限制每周期取指、重命名和提交最多各四条。<bookmark mark='b'/>就绪操作竞争执行资源。这个实现每周期最多启动六个操作，其中算术逻辑操作最多四个、内存操作最多两个，还受乘法器与除法器的限制。因此讨论宽度时必须说明具体阶段。<bookmark mark='c'/>完成的结果唤醒依赖者，体系结构提交仍按序。优先选择最老就绪指令是本模型的策略，并非所有处理器的硬性要求。<bookmark mark='d'/>本模型把结果放在指令记录中，提交时复制寄存器结果。另一些设计先写推测物理寄存器，再提交映射。它们的重排序缓冲区不只保存指针，还需要完成、异常与恢复元数据。

623b43a75686.en: The cycle-by-cycle functional core is implemented in the repository. Its values are computed by the simulator, rather than read from the offline scheduling oracle. <bookmark mark='a'/> The current test suite compares a hundred twenty generated programs across six configurations with the instruction emulator. A Job paragraph is checked in two predictor configurations. Final registers, memory, output and committed instruction counts must match. These finite tests are evidence, not a proof for every program. <bookmark mark='b'/> Directed cases exercise divide-zero state, memory-order replay, partial store forwarding and this modeled Spectre gadget. <bookmark mark='c'/> Wrong-path loads access the model's byte array and optional cache. That distinction between uncommitted architectural work and persistent modeled cache effects will drive the security chapter.
623b43a75686.zh: 仓库中实现了逐周期功能模型核。它的值由模拟器计算，而不是从离线调度先知里读取。<bookmark mark='a'/>当前测试把一百二十个生成程序在六种配置下与指令模拟器对照，并把一个任务段落在两种预测配置下对照。最终寄存器、内存、输出与提交指令数必须相同。这些有限测试提供证据，并不是对所有程序的证明。<bookmark mark='b'/>定向用例还检查除零状态、内存顺序重放、部分存数转发，以及这个模型化的幽灵片段。<bookmark mark='c'/>错误路径上的取数访问模型字节数组和可选缓存。未提交的体系结构工作与保留的模型缓存效果之间的区别，是安全章节的关键。

c680b1fa38ff.en: Limit studies inspired by David Wall's 1991 work schedule a recorded execution under progressively changed assumptions. Our bars change one assumption at a time from the same baseline; they are not cumulative stages. <bookmark mark='a'/> Unlimited start width and lookahead, fixed latencies, perfect path and word-address knowledge, register renaming and omitted realistic I/O ordering produce about twenty-four hundred instructions per modeled cycle on this trace. <bookmark mark='b'/> Adding register-name constraints alone gives about three point seven. <bookmark mark='c'/> Making loads wait for earlier store addresses instead gives about sixty-two. <bookmark mark='d'/> Keeping the other oracle powers but adding tournament-predicted control barriers gives about three point four. <bookmark mark='e'/> Barriers at every branch and jump give under one half. These are sensitivities of a particular trace scheduler, not attainable processor specifications or universal program limits.
c680b1fa38ff.zh: 受大卫·沃尔一九九一年研究启发的极限研究，会改变假设并调度已记录的执行。这里每条柱都相对同一基线只改变一种假设，不是逐步累加限制。<bookmark mark='a'/>无限启动宽度与向前查看、固定延迟、完整路径与字地址信息、寄存器重命名，以及省略真实输入输出顺序，使这条轨迹达到每个模型周期约两千四百条指令。<bookmark mark='b'/>只加入寄存器名称约束，得到约三点七。<bookmark mark='c'/>改为让取数等待先前存数地址，则约为六十二。<bookmark mark='d'/>保留其他先知能力，加入锦标赛预测控制屏障，约为三点四。<bookmark mark='e'/>在每个分支和跳转处都设置屏障，结果低于零点五。这些是特定轨迹调度器对假设的敏感性，不是可实现处理器的规格，也不是程序的普遍极限。

f63e25924327.en: Now vary start width and the scheduler's window parameter. This parameter constrains an instruction's start relative to the start of an earlier trace position. It does not wait for the oldest unfinished operation to retire, so it is not a physical reorder-buffer capacity. <bookmark mark='a'/> With the modeled predictor barriers, curves for the tested window parameters almost overlap and flatten near three point four. That shows little benefit from this parameter on this trace under these assumptions. <bookmark mark='b'/> With perfect control, a parameter of one hundred twenty-eight permits considerably more overlap. <bookmark mark='c'/> Two thousand forty-eight permits still more. Control assumptions interact strongly with start-width and lookahead assumptions here. The result does not prove that larger buffers are useless on other programs, or that the oracle's distant future inputs can be supplied by hardware.
f63e25924327.zh: 现在改变启动宽度和调度器的窗口参数。这个参数把某条指令的启动时刻限制在先前某个轨迹位置的启动之后；它不等待最老未完成操作提交，因此不是物理重排序缓冲区容量。<bookmark mark='a'/>加入模型中的预测屏障后，所测试窗口参数的曲线几乎重合，并在约三点四处变平。这说明在这条轨迹和这些假设下，该参数带来的收益很小。<bookmark mark='b'/>控制完全已知时，参数一百二十八允许更多重叠。<bookmark mark='c'/>参数两千零四十八允许更多。这里控制假设与启动宽度、向前查看假设有很强的相互作用。结果没有证明更大缓冲区对别的程序无用，也没有证明硬件能够提供先知所用的遥远未来输入。

7428c694b839.en: Compare that oracle with the functional core's actual model runs. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each heatmap cell reports retired IPC while varying the front-end and retirement width, reorder-buffer capacity and proportional queue sizes. The four-width configuration is about one point eight nine; eight increases it only slightly on this chapter. Execution starts have their own unit and port limits. <bookmark mark='b'/> Increasing these capacities beyond the smaller tested settings brings little benefit here. That is a workload-specific observation, consistent with low whole-run occupancy. <bookmark mark='c'/> Oracle-assisted correct-path prediction improves IPC substantially, but the implementation can still redirect after speculative memory-order mistakes. Front-end taken-branch bandwidth, memory ports and other resources remain constraints; this sweep alone does not uniquely assign the remaining gap to one of them.
7428c694b839.zh: 再把这个先知与功能模型核的实际运行比较。<bookmark mark='a'/>热图每格报告提交指令的平均每周期数量，同时改变前端与提交宽度、重排序缓冲区容量，以及按比例设置的队列容量。四宽配置约为一点八九，八宽在本章只多一点。执行启动另有部件与端口限制。<bookmark mark='b'/>超过较小的已测配置后，增加这些容量收益很小。这是特定工作负载的现象，与全程占用较低相符。<bookmark mark='c'/>正确路径先知辅助预测会明显提高吞吐，但推测内存顺序出错后，实现仍可能重定向。前端每周期可越过的已取分支数量、内存端口及其他资源仍有限制；仅靠这张扫描图不能把剩余差距唯一归因于某一种资源。

68f0a505179a.en: This illustrates an instruction-level parallelism trade-off. <bookmark mark='a'/> An offline oracle exposes large overlap by supplying knowledge and resources that a real core lacks. Its twenty-four-hundred figure is not independently available hardware parallelism. <bookmark mark='b'/> Finite lookahead, prediction, memory ordering and front-end bandwidth restrict useful overlap in the functional model. Larger windows can still help other workloads, especially when they expose independent misses or long-latency work. <bookmark mark='c'/> Increasing width also adds bypass, selection, port, wiring and energy costs. Those costs depend on the implementation; not every design uses one fully connected broadcast structure. <bookmark mark='d'/> Designers balance wider cores, caches, multiple cores and other techniques. Fetch, decode, issue and retirement widths are different metrics, and there is no universal four-to-eight-wide stopping point.
68f0a505179a.zh: 这里展示的是指令级并行的权衡。<bookmark mark='a'/>离线先知提供真实处理器缺少的知识和资源，从而暴露大量重叠。两千四百这个数字不是硬件可独立获得的并行度。<bookmark mark='b'/>有限的向前查看、预测、内存顺序和前端带宽限制了功能模型中的有用重叠。更大窗口仍可能帮助别的负载，尤其是能发现独立缺失或长延迟工作时。<bookmark mark='c'/>增加宽度还会带来旁路、选择、端口、布线与能耗成本，具体取决于实现，并非每种设计都使用一个全连接广播结构。<bookmark mark='d'/>设计者在更宽的核、缓存、多核和其他技术之间权衡。取指、译码、发射与提交宽度是不同指标，不存在通用的四到八宽终点。

a2cb58fd8e3b.en: Prediction lets fetch proceed before a branch resolves. <bookmark mark='a'/> Fetch follows a predicted direction and target, within its bandwidth limits. <bookmark mark='b'/> Younger operations may be renamed and execute when their operands, resources and ordering rules allow. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ordered retirement prevents younger architectural effects from committing past an unresolved older branch. It does not keep every physical result or cache effect inside the reorder buffer. <bookmark mark='d'/> A wrong direction or target discards younger work, repairs register mappings and recovery state, and redirects fetch. Our simulator rebuilds its alias table from surviving entries. Physical processors use different mixtures of checkpoints and rollback; checkpoint availability and front-end refill affect recovery time. A single-cycle universal repair rule would be misleading.
a2cb58fd8e3b.zh: 预测让取指能够在分支解决之前继续。<bookmark mark='a'/>取指在带宽限制内沿预测方向和目标前进。<bookmark mark='b'/>较年轻操作可以重命名，并在操作数、资源和顺序规则允许时执行。<bookmark mark='c'/>按序提交阻止较年轻体系结构效果越过未解决的较老分支生效，但不会把所有物理结果和缓存效果都关在重排序缓冲区里。<bookmark mark='d'/>方向或目标出错时，模型丢弃较年轻工作，修复寄存器映射与恢复状态，并重定向取指。本模拟器从保留表项重建别名表。物理处理器会组合使用检查点和回滚，检查点数量与前端重新填充都会影响恢复时间，不能说所有实现都在一个周期内恢复。

316a284077e6.en: This is a recorded branch redirect in the functional core. Grey covers fetch and decode; the other colors distinguish waiting, execution, completion and retirement. <bookmark mark='a'/> The prediction follows a same-length entry into the letter-comparison path. <bookmark mark='b'/> Eleven displayed younger entries are later squashed. They reached different stages; some executed and some only waited. <bookmark mark='c'/> The resolved branch selects the different-length path. No younger entry has retired, but its resource use and any modeled cache effects still matter. <bookmark mark='d'/> The chart measures about eight cycles from the branch's rename to the first refetched instruction's rename. That interval includes branch execution and front-end progress. Recovery penalty depends on the timestamps and configuration; it is not a universal constant for all branches or processors.
316a284077e6.zh: 这是功能模型核中记录的一次分支重定向。灰色表示取指与译码，其他颜色区分等待、执行、完成与提交。<bookmark mark='a'/>预测沿相同长度条目进入字母比较路径。<bookmark mark='b'/>图中十一项较年轻指令随后被清除，它们到达的阶段不同，有些执行了，有些只是在等待。<bookmark mark='c'/>实际分支选择长度不同的路径。较年轻表项没有提交，但占用的资源及模型缓存效果仍然重要。<bookmark mark='d'/>图中从分支重命名到第一条重新取入指令重命名，约隔八个周期。这段时间包含分支执行和前端推进。恢复代价取决于时间戳定义与配置，并不是所有分支或处理器的通用常数。

c4b374b38af7.en: Two useful ratios summarize these runs, but neither is a hard lookahead bound. <bookmark mark='a'/> Retired instructions divided by the model's counted branch redirects is about thirty-seven. Redirects include some wrong-path branches, so this is an aggregate ratio, not the exact spacing of correct-path prediction misses. Miss spacing and branch-resolution latency vary; a core can have several unresolved branches in flight. <bookmark mark='b'/> Define an effective penalty P from the CPI difference between tournament and oracle-assisted runs, normalized by that redirect rate. <bookmark mark='c'/> The resulting P is about seven point nine cycles. It summarizes the entire configuration comparison, including interactions with resource use, cache state and memory-order recovery; it is not a unique measured cost of every redirect. <bookmark mark='d'/> The low mean occupancy and flat capacity sweep are observations about this workload. Better prediction helps here, while a larger window can help under other dependencies and miss patterns.
c4b374b38af7.zh: 两个比值能概括这些运行，但都不是向前查看距离的硬上限。<bookmark mark='a'/>提交指令数除以模型统计的分支重定向次数，约为三十七。重定向还包含部分错误路径分支，所以这只是汇总比值，不是正确路径预测失误的精确间距。失误间隔与分支解决延迟各不相同，一个核也可以同时容纳多个尚未解决的分支。<bookmark mark='b'/>把锦标赛与先知辅助运行之间的每指令周期差，用该重定向率归一化，定义有效代价 P。<bookmark mark='c'/>得到的 P 约为七点九个周期。它概括整个配置对比，包括资源、缓存状态和内存顺序恢复之间的相互作用，不是每次重定向唯一的实测代价。<bookmark mark='d'/>平均占用低、容量扫描曲线平坦，都是这个负载的观察结果。更好预测在这里有帮助，而其他依赖和缺失模式下，更大窗口也可能有帮助。

d617f086ab89.en: Register names are available at decode, but effective memory addresses may depend on unfinished arithmetic. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here an older store waits for its address in a3, while a younger load already knows s0 plus four. <bookmark mark='b'/> If their byte ranges overlap, the load must observe the correct older store's bytes, perhaps through forwarding or after waiting. Equal starting addresses are only one overlap case. <bookmark mark='c'/> Disjoint byte ranges remove this particular dependency, though resources and other ordering rules still apply. <bookmark mark='d'/> Until the store address is known, the core must either wait conservatively or speculate and later check. That is the memory-disambiguation problem in this single-core model.
d617f086ab89.zh: 寄存器名称在译码时已知，但有效内存地址可能依赖尚未完成的计算。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里较老存数等待寄存器 a3 中的地址，较年轻取数已知地址为 s0 加四。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果它们访问的字节范围重叠，取数必须看到正确的较老存数所写的字节，可能通过转发，也可能先等待。起始地址相等只是重叠的一种情况。<bookmark mark='c'/>字节范围互不相交时，这一项依赖消失，但资源和其他顺序规则仍然有效。<bookmark mark='d'/>存数地址尚未确定时，核必须保守等待，或者先推测、之后再检查。这就是这个单核模型中的内存消歧问题。

882854b4db46.en: The load and store queues retain program-order relationships among memory operations. <bookmark mark='a'/> In this simulator, stores compute address and data early but write the byte array only at retirement. A squashed store does not commit that write. Real processors can have earlier store-related cache or coherence effects, which this rule does not model. <bookmark mark='b'/> A load searches for the youngest relevant older store. If that store covers all requested bytes and its data is ready, it can forward the value. This implementation waits on partial overlaps rather than merging several stores. <bookmark mark='c'/> Conservative disambiguation waits for unknown older store addresses. Speculative disambiguation proceeds and checks later. The load-PC wait table conservatively retrains previously violating loads; it is a simplified policy inspired by historical load-wait predictors, not a complete store-set predictor.
882854b4db46.zh: 取数与存数队列保留内存操作之间的程序顺序。<bookmark mark='a'/>本模拟器可以提前计算存数地址和数据，但只在提交时写字节数组。被清除的存数不会提交该写入。真实处理器可能更早产生与存数有关的缓存或一致性效果，这条模型规则没有覆盖那些效果。<bookmark mark='b'/>取数寻找最近且相关的较老存数。如果它覆盖全部所需字节，而且数据已就绪，就能转发结果。本实现遇到部分重叠会等待，不会合并多个存数。<bookmark mark='c'/>保守策略等待地址未知的较老存数；推测策略先执行、之后检查。按取数位置索引的等待表会让曾违规的取数转为保守等待。这是受历史取数等待预测器启发的简化策略，不是完整的存数集合预测器。

9a3d8e41e36f.en: This recorded example makes the ordering mistake visible. <bookmark mark='a'/> A younger load executes before the older store's address is ready and reads zero from memory. <bookmark mark='b'/> The delayed address resolves to the same word, which the older store must write with seventy-seven. <bookmark mark='c'/> The model detects the overlapping younger load, squashes it and its dependents, and refetches. The corrected load obtains seventy-seven after the required older-store ordering is respected. In this recording the store retires before the replayed load starts; forwarding can satisfy other valid cases before a store retires. <bookmark mark='d'/> The speculative run takes thirty-five cycles and the conservative one twenty-nine. Speculation is not always faster: a wrong guess can cost more than the waiting it avoided.
9a3d8e41e36f.zh: 这个记录下来的例子让顺序错误清楚可见。<bookmark mark='a'/>较年轻取数在较老存数地址就绪之前执行，从内存读到零。<bookmark mark='b'/>延迟的地址最终指向同一个字，较老存数必须把七十七写到那里。<bookmark mark='c'/>模型发现重叠的较年轻取数，清除它和依赖者，然后重新取指。修正后的取数遵守较老存数顺序，得到七十七。在这段记录中，存数先提交，重放的取数随后才启动；其他合法情形也可能在存数提交之前通过转发满足取数。<bookmark mark='d'/>推测运行用三十五个周期，保守运行用二十九个周期。推测并非总是更快：猜错的代价可能超过省下的等待。

7a32e7ec219e.en: Now use a histogram workload with fifteen hundred fixed-seed samples. Each sample sits on a separate modeled cache line, and its value selects the counter to update. <bookmark mark='a'/> A sample miss delays the older store's counter address. Waiting behind every such unknown address makes this conservative run expensive. <bookmark mark='b'/> Speculating allows later loads to overlap those misses, greatly reducing this workload's modeled cycles. <bookmark mark='c'/> The twenty-three violations are dynamic detected events across the run, not twenty-three distinct static load instructions. The wait-table run changes which loads wait after observed violations. <bookmark mark='d'/> These results depend on the generated samples, cache model and queue policy. Real processor memory-order recovery events have architecture-specific counters and meanings; availability and access permissions must be checked on the particular machine.
7a32e7ec219e.zh: 现在换成包含一千五百个固定种子样本的直方图负载。每个样本位于独立的模型缓存行，它的值决定更新哪个计数器。<bookmark mark='a'/>样本缺失会延迟较老存数的计数器地址。若等待每个这样的未知地址，保守运行就会很慢。<bookmark mark='b'/>推测允许后续取数与这些缺失重叠，大幅减少这个负载的模型周期。<bookmark mark='c'/>二十三次违规是完整运行中检测到的动态事件，不是二十三条不同的静态取数指令。等待表运行会根据已观察到的违规，改变哪些取数需要等待。<bookmark mark='d'/>结果取决于生成样本、缓存模型和队列策略。真实处理器的内存顺序恢复事件具有架构特定的计数器与含义，必须检查具体机器是否支持，以及是否有访问权限。

5e5a09ffa455.en: The Job's first chapter behaves differently. <bookmark mark='a'/> All three tested disambiguation policies give the same four hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred eighty model cycles. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its recorded trace has a hundred fifty-four thousand eight hundred thirty-five loads and five thousand two hundred seventy stores. Stores update counts, table metadata and the letter pool. These runs show no benefit from changing the tested policy; they do not prove that every load is independent or that memory disambiguation never matters. Different workloads expose different bottlenecks.
5e5a09ffa455.zh: 任务第一章的情况不同。<bookmark mark='a'/>三种已测试消歧策略都得到相同的四十三万七千五百八十个模型周期。<bookmark mark='b'/>记录的轨迹包含十五万四千八百三十五次取数和五千二百七十次存数。存数既更新计数，也写词表元数据和字母池。这些运行没有从改变所测策略中获益，但没有证明所有取数都独立，也没有证明内存消歧永远不重要。不同负载暴露不同瓶颈。

47fe3c172be2.en: We will demonstrate a cache timing channel entirely inside the functional simulator. The victim and observer share its byte-array memory and a probe array. The observer can evict and time probe lines using model devices. <bookmark mark='a'/> Allocate two hundred fifty-six probe lines, one for each possible byte value. The diagram shows sixteen of them. <bookmark mark='b'/> A victim access leaves its selected line in the modeled cache. Access assigns a two-cycle hit or sixty-cycle miss and allocates a missed line immediately; it is a simplified cache model. <bookmark mark='c'/> Timing later accesses distinguishes a warm line from cold ones; the measured interval includes the timer and surrounding instructions. <bookmark mark='d'/> Flush-and-reload-style attacks exploit this kind of observable shared state on suitable hardware. Our demonstration supplies those sharing and timing assumptions explicitly and does not extract secrets from the host processor.
47fe3c172be2.zh: 我们完全在功能模拟器内演示缓存计时通道。受害代码与观察者共享模型字节数组和探测数组，观察者可以通过模型设备逐出缓存行并计时。<bookmark mark='a'/>分配二百五十六条探测行，对应每个可能字节值，图中只画十六条。<bookmark mark='b'/>受害代码的访问会让选中的行留在模拟缓存里。模型指定命中两个周期、缺失六十个周期，并在缺失访问时立即分配缓存行；这是简化缓存模型。<bookmark mark='c'/>之后计时访问，就能区分热行和冷行。测量区间还包含计时器与周围指令。<bookmark mark='d'/>在条件合适的硬件上，冲刷后重载一类攻击会利用这种可观察的共享状态。本演示明确提供共享与计时条件，并不从宿主处理器中提取秘密。

0b1e4df53fe7.en: The victim interface accepts an unsigned word-sized index and a nonempty sixteen-byte array. <bookmark mark='a'/> On architectural execution, the unsigned bounds check rejects indices at or above the array size. An accepted byte selects one probe line. <bookmark mark='b'/> The assembly uses an unsigned branch, then loads the byte and shifts it by six to select a sixty-four-byte line. The adjacent secret is outside the victim interface's permitted array, but inside the same modeled address space. This is a software bounds policy, not a hardware page-permission boundary. <bookmark mark='c'/> The secret bytes spell PEBBLE and begin at index sixteen. Correct architectural control flow rejects those indices. The experiment asks whether transient execution can nevertheless encode their values in the simulated cache.
0b1e4df53fe7.zh: 受害接口接收一个无符号机器字索引，数组非空，长度为十六字节。<bookmark mark='a'/>按体系结构执行时，无符号边界检查会拒绝大于等于数组大小的索引，被接受的字节用于选择探测行。<bookmark mark='b'/>汇编先执行无符号分支，再取出字节并左移六位，选择六十四字节的缓存行。相邻秘密位于受害接口允许数组之外，但仍在同一个模型地址空间内。这是软件边界策略，不是硬件页权限边界。<bookmark mark='c'/>秘密字节拼成 PEBBLE，从索引十六开始。正确的体系结构控制流会拒绝这些索引。实验要问的是，瞬态执行是否仍能把它们编码进模拟缓存。

dd34602e34e6.en: Follow the actual program order in the simulated attack. <bookmark mark='a'/> First flush all probe lines, then make six in-bounds training calls. The allowed array contains zeros, so those calls warm probe line zero. <bookmark mark='b'/> Next evict the size variable and execute the model's timer barrier before the attack call. The next bounds check must wait for the modeled miss. <bookmark mark='c'/> Call with index sixteen, then successive secret positions. Prediction follows the in-bounds path while the size is delayed. A transient byte load reads P and a dependent access selects its probe line. The timing diagram illustrates that overlap; it is not a gate-level timing trace. <bookmark mark='d'/> Once the size arrives, the branch rejects the index and squashes younger architectural results. The selected probe line remains warm in this model. That observable cache effect is exactly why saying the access never happened would be wrong.
dd34602e34e6.zh: 按模拟攻击程序的实际顺序来走。<bookmark mark='a'/>先逐出全部探测行，再调用六次合法索引进行训练。合法数组里全是零，因此训练会把探测行零变热。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后逐出大小变量，并在攻击调用前执行模型计时器屏障。下一次边界检查必须等待模型缺失。<bookmark mark='c'/>用索引十六调用，之后依次使用秘密位置。大小尚未返回时，预测沿合法路径前进，瞬态字节取数读出 P，依赖访问选择它对应的探测行。时序图示意这种重叠，不是门级时序记录。<bookmark mark='d'/>大小返回后，分支拒绝该索引，清除较年轻的体系结构结果。但模型中被选中的探测行仍是热的。正因为这个缓存效果可被观察，不能说那次访问从未发生。

d8cd3d7d2a26.en: The actual attack probes indices one through two hundred fifty-five. Line zero is intentionally omitted because the training calls warm it, so this simple decoder cannot recover a zero-valued secret byte. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each plotted measurement is the difference between two model-counter reads around one probe access. <bookmark mark='b'/> In the first round, line eighty, ASCII P, is the uniquely fast tested line. It takes five measured cycles versus sixty-three for the other tested lines, including timing overhead. <bookmark mark='c'/> Repeating the procedure recovers the six supplied nonzero secret bytes, PEBBLE, in this model. That is a concrete simulated witness under the stated shared-memory and timing capabilities, not evidence of a leak from arbitrary host memory.
d8cd3d7d2a26.zh: 实际攻击只探测索引一到二百五十五。训练会把行零变热，所以故意排除它；这个简单解码器因而无法恢复值为零的秘密字节。<bookmark mark='a'/>图中每次测量都是围绕一次探测访问，读取两次模型计数器后求差。<bookmark mark='b'/>第一轮唯一快的已测行是八十，即 ASCII 的 P。包含计时开销后，它用五个周期，其他已测行用六十三个周期。<bookmark mark='c'/>重复这个过程，就能在模型中恢复给定的六个非零秘密字节 PEBBLE。这是在已说明的共享内存与计时能力下的具体模拟例证，不是从任意宿主内存泄漏的证据。

24b17dd6278f.en: Compare two mitigations for this gadget. <bookmark mark='a'/> The first inserts our custom serializing timer read after the check. In this program its known device address lets the model recognize the barrier and prevent younger issue until it retires. This is not a universal description of x86 RDTSC or LFENCE; real barriers require the specified ISA and vendor protocol. <bookmark mark='b'/> The second makes the array index depend on the unsigned bounds result: all ones for an allowed index, zero otherwise. <bookmark mark='c'/> Here array element zero exists, so the out-of-bounds transient path is redirected to a valid element. Compilers and hardware must preserve the dependency for such hardening to work. <bookmark mark='d'/> Both tested runs fail to recover the supplied secret from the nonzero probe lines. That finite result is not a proof against every speculative channel. <bookmark mark='e'/> The benign-call costs shown below are specific to this program and model. Real applications need their own correctness, performance and threat-model evaluation.
24b17dd6278f.zh: 比较这个片段的两种缓解办法。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一种在检查后插入自定义串行化计时器读取。这个程序中的设备地址已知，模型能识别屏障，并阻止较年轻指令发射，直到它提交。这不是对 x86 计时指令或 LFENCE 的通用描述，真实屏障必须遵循指令集和厂商规定的协议。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二种让数组索引依赖无符号边界比较结果：合法时掩码全一，否则全零。<bookmark mark='c'/>这里数组元素零确实存在，所以越界瞬态路径会转到合法元素。编译器和硬件必须保留依赖，这种加固才有效。<bookmark mark='d'/>两个已测试运行都无法从非零探测行恢复给定秘密，但有限结果并不是对所有推测通道的证明。<bookmark mark='e'/>下面的正常调用成本仅适用于本程序和模型。真实应用需要单独评估正确性、性能与威胁模型。

99c3f9af5c70.en: Spectre and Meltdown were publicly disclosed in January 2018, with variants affecting different processor implementations. <bookmark mark='a'/> Spectre-style attacks manipulate predictions to induce transient computations that reveal information through observable microarchitectural state. Our example is bounds-check bypass, not every Spectre variant. <bookmark mark='b'/> Meltdown's original attack exploited delayed enforcement of access restrictions on affected processors. Its prerequisites and mitigations differ from this shared-address-space victim-interface experiment. <bookmark mark='c'/> Operating systems, browsers, compilers and processors have adopted multiple defenses, including isolation, hardening and prediction controls. Their applicability depends on architecture, version, configuration and threat model. Speculation does not by itself imply that every implementation is vulnerable to every attack, and precise architectural exceptions alone do not establish security.
99c3f9af5c70.zh: 幽灵与熔断在二零一八年一月公开披露，不同变体影响不同处理器实现。<bookmark mark='a'/>幽灵类攻击操纵预测，诱发瞬态计算，再通过可观察的微体系结构状态泄漏信息。这里的例子是边界检查绕过，不代表全部幽灵变体。<bookmark mark='b'/>最初的熔断攻击利用受影响处理器延迟落实访问限制的行为，其前提和缓解方法，与这里共享地址空间的受害接口实验不同。<bookmark mark='c'/>操作系统、浏览器、编译器和处理器采用了隔离、加固、预测控制等多种防御，适用性取决于架构、版本、配置和威胁模型。采用推测执行，不表示每种实现都会受到每种攻击；仅有精确体系结构异常，也不能证明安全。

5993afa02224.en: Dynamic scheduling spends hardware on dependency checking, wakeup and selection. <bookmark mark='a'/> A straightforward W-wide rename stage compares destinations and sources within the incoming group, giving a quadratic family of comparisons. Implementations can organize that logic differently. <bookmark mark='b'/> Waiting instructions must learn when their operands become available, and ready operations must compete for resources. <bookmark mark='c'/> Very Long Instruction Word designs move more scheduling decisions into the compiler, which places operations into explicit issue groups. <bookmark mark='d'/> The hardware still decodes, executes and handles the ISA's timing, memory and exception rules. Some designs retain interlocks, caches and variable-latency operations. Static scheduling changes where decisions are made; it does not eliminate every hardware scheduling or correctness mechanism.
5993afa02224.zh: 动态调度需要硬件检查依赖、唤醒指令并选择操作。<bookmark mark='a'/>直接实现的 W 宽重命名阶段会比较同批输入中的目标与源，形成一组二次规模的比较，但实现可以采用不同组织方式。<bookmark mark='b'/>等待指令需要知道操作数何时可用，就绪操作还必须竞争资源。<bookmark mark='c'/>超长指令字设计把更多调度决定交给编译器，把操作放进明确的发射组。<bookmark mark='d'/>硬件仍须译码、执行，并落实指令集的时序、内存与异常规则。有些设计保留互锁、缓存和变延迟操作。静态调度改变的是决定发生在哪里，并没有消除所有硬件调度或正确性机制。

a9c69be5a68d.en: Use the six-operation mismatched-length path as a scheduling illustration with four start slots. This is not an executable VLIW translation of the whole search. <bookmark mark='a'/> Under the chart's same-bundle read-before-write convention, the load and table-end test read old register versions while the increments produce later versions. That convention must be part of a real target's semantics. <bookmark mark='b'/> With a two-cycle load and these fixed data dependencies, the comparison cannot start in the next cycle, leaving an empty bundle in this candidate schedule. <bookmark mark='c'/> The displayed operations occupy three cycles and six of twelve slots. Actual exits, multiple control operations in a bundle, safe early loads and side effects need a complete control and guard policy before this could replace the original program.
a9c69be5a68d.zh: 用长度不匹配路径的六个操作，演示四个启动槽的调度。这不是整个搜索的可执行超长指令字翻译。<bookmark mark='a'/>图中约定同一束先读后写，因此取数与表尾检查读取旧寄存器版本，递增产生后续版本。真实目标必须明确支持这样的语义。<bookmark mark='b'/>取数延迟两个周期，在固定数据依赖下，比较不能紧接下一周期启动，这个候选调度因此空出一束。<bookmark mark='c'/>图中操作占三个周期，十二个槽里用了六个。实际退出、一束中的多个控制操作、提前取数的安全性与副作用，都需要完整的控制和保护策略，才能代替原程序。

ae91fffc480a.en: Software pipelining overlaps operations from successive loop trips. The colors distinguish trips in this fixed-path scheduling illustration. <bookmark mark='a'/> Address increments permit some work for the next trip to begin before the previous trip's load-dependent comparison finishes. Here the modulo placement satisfies the displayed data and start-slot constraints. <bookmark mark='b'/> Six operations and four slots give a resource initiation-interval lower bound of two cycles; the one-cycle address recurrence gives another lower bound of one. Their maximum is two. A complete loop implementation must also preserve live versions, define control within bundles, handle startup and drain, guard speculative loads, and recover on exits. The picture does not verify those full-program requirements or establish an achieved hardware throughput.
ae91fffc480a.zh: 软件流水把连续几趟循环的操作重叠起来，颜色在这张固定路径调度图中区分不同趟次。<bookmark mark='a'/>地址递增使下一趟部分工作能够早于上一趟依赖取数的比较开始。这里的模排布满足图中的数据与启动槽约束。<bookmark mark='b'/>六个操作、四个槽，给出的资源启动间隔下界是两个周期；单周期地址递推给出另一个下界，一个周期。二者最大值为二。完整循环实现还须保留存活版本、规定束内控制、处理启动与排空、保护推测取数，并在退出时恢复。这张图没有验证那些全程序要求，也没有证明实际硬件达到该吞吐量。

32f88984fc65.en: Static and dynamic scheduling make different trade-offs. <bookmark mark='a'/> Cache misses and variable execution times can invalidate a compiler's preferred timing. Depending on the ISA, interlocks or other mechanisms preserve correctness, sometimes by stalling. <bookmark mark='b'/> Data-dependent branches require control flow, predication, speculation or guarded schedules; a compiler need not know every runtime outcome in advance. <bookmark mark='c'/> A schedule tuned for one implementation can perform poorly on another. Compatible hardware can preserve the program's meaning without recompilation; a changed width does not automatically make old code wrong. <bookmark mark='d'/> Itanium's EPIC approach included features such as predication and advanced loads and faced several commercial and technical challenges. One simple bundle chart cannot explain its whole history. <bookmark mark='e'/> VLIW remains useful in some DSPs and accelerators, where workload knowledge and implementation choices can make static scheduling attractive, even when real systems still contain caches or variable-latency events.
32f88984fc65.zh: 静态与动态调度有不同权衡。<bookmark mark='a'/>缓存缺失和变化的执行时间会破坏编译器偏好的时序。指令集不同，互锁或其他机制会负责保持正确性，有时需要停顿。<bookmark mark='b'/>依赖数据的分支需要控制流、谓词、推测或受保护调度；编译器不必预先知道每次运行结果。<bookmark mark='c'/>针对一种实现优化的调度，在另一种实现上可能表现不好，但兼容硬件可以在不重新编译的情况下保持程序含义。宽度改变不会自动让旧代码出错。<bookmark mark='d'/>安腾的显式并行方法包含谓词与高级取数等特性，并面临多方面商业和技术挑战，一张简单指令束图无法解释全部历史。<bookmark mark='e'/>超长指令字仍用于一些数字信号处理器与加速器。对负载的了解和实现选择，可能使静态调度有吸引力，即使系统仍有缓存或变延迟事件。

692c459865ad.en: Return to execution time: instruction count times cycles per instruction times clock period. <bookmark mark='a'/> Rich instructions can express more work per architectural instruction, reducing the count for some programs. Their implementation may use direct hardware or microcode; not every complex instruction is slow or microcoded. <bookmark mark='b'/> RISC projects emphasized simpler operations, regular encoding and efficient pipelines. The goal of starting or completing one operation per cycle is a throughput goal, not a claim that every load, divide or other instruction has one-cycle latency. <bookmark mark='c'/> Compiler quality, memory behavior and implementation choices affect all three factors in the equation, so instruction-set labels alone do not determine performance. <bookmark mark='d'/> IBM 801, Berkeley RISC and Stanford MIPS are influential examples. Their lessons concern measured workload and implementation trade-offs, rather than a universal rule that fewer instructions or simpler instructions must always win.
692c459865ad.zh: 回到执行时间：指令数乘每指令周期，再乘时钟周期。<bookmark mark='a'/>丰富指令可以在一条体系结构指令中表达更多工作，为某些程序减少指令数。实现可能使用直接硬件或微码，并非每条复杂指令都慢或都用微码。<bookmark mark='b'/>精简指令集项目强调较简单的操作、规整编码与高效流水线。每周期启动或完成一个操作是吞吐目标，不是说每次取数、除法或其他指令的延迟都只有一个周期。<bookmark mark='c'/>编译器质量、内存行为与实现选择会影响公式中的三个因子，仅凭指令集标签不能确定性能。<bookmark mark='d'/>IBM 801、伯克利精简指令集和斯坦福 MIPS 是有影响的例子。它们的经验在于测量负载与实现权衡，不是“指令更少”或“指令更简单”就永远更快的通用法则。

7e1963aca2b8.en: This is the Job's dynamic instruction mix on Pebble, not a measured translation to another ISA. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its arithmetic, branches, loads and jumps dominate the recorded chapter. <bookmark mark='b'/> An x86 compare can read a memory operand directly, but the conditional jump still remains. Our Pebble load followed by a combined compare-and-branch can therefore map to a memory compare plus a jump: two architectural instructions, not one. <bookmark mark='c'/> The trace heuristic finds ninety thousand seven hundred twenty-six loads whose result feeds the next instruction and soon becomes dead. That is about fifty-nine percent of the loads. It is a local use pattern, not a count of legal folded x86 instructions or an eleven-percent instruction reduction. Addressing, flags, branches, register allocation and actual code generation must be included in such a comparison.
7e1963aca2b8.zh: 这是任务在 Pebble 上的动态指令组成，不是翻译到另一种指令集后的实测结果。<bookmark mark='a'/>记录的这一章主要由算术、分支、取数和跳转组成。<bookmark mark='b'/>x86 比较可以直接读取内存操作数，但条件跳转仍然存在。因此 Pebble 的取数加一条比较分支，可能对应内存比较加跳转，仍是两条体系结构指令，不是一条。<bookmark mark='c'/>轨迹启发式找到九万零七百二十六次取数，其结果供下一条指令使用，并很快失效，约占全部取数的百分之五十九。这是局部使用模式，不是合法 x86 折叠指令数量，也不是指令减少百分之十一。真正比较还必须考虑寻址、标志、分支、寄存器分配与实际代码生成。

67f141f1744a.en: Many modern x86 implementations decode architectural instructions into internal micro-operations. <bookmark mark='a'/> This conceptual read-modify-write example separates memory reading, arithmetic and memory writing; exact micro-operations and flags behavior depend on the implementation. <bookmark mark='b'/> An out-of-order design can rename and schedule those internal operations. They are not literally a separate RISC instruction set, and not every x86 processor uses the same organization. <bookmark mark='c'/> Some designs fuse a load with an operation for part of the pipeline; macro-fusion of a compare and conditional branch is a different mechanism. Architectural instruction counts, reorder-buffer entries and execution operations can therefore differ. <bookmark mark='d'/> Encoding is another independent choice. x86 uses variable-length encodings; some RISC ISAs also mix lengths, including Thumb and compressed RISC-V. A base instruction-set category does not specify every pipeline detail.
67f141f1744a.zh: 许多现代 x86 实现把体系结构指令译成内部微操作。<bookmark mark='a'/>这个概念性的读改写例子把内存读取、算术与内存写入分开；具体微操作和标志行为取决于实现。<bookmark mark='b'/>乱序设计可以对内部操作重命名和调度。它们并不真的是另一套精简指令集，也不是所有 x86 处理器都采用相同组织。<bookmark mark='c'/>某些设计会在部分流水线中把取数与运算融合，而比较和条件跳转的宏融合是另一种机制。因此体系结构指令数、重排序表项数与执行操作数可能不同。<bookmark mark='d'/>编码是另一个独立选择。x86 使用变长编码，有些精简指令集也混合长度，例如 Thumb 与压缩 RISC-V。指令集的基本类别不能决定全部流水线细节。

54eef854d93c.en: Instruction sets preserve software investments while implementations evolve. <bookmark mark='a'/> x86 compatibility is extensive, but availability depends on execution mode, extensions and operating-system support; not literally every instruction from 1978 runs unchanged in every modern mode. <bookmark mark='b'/> Arm designs span many implementations and markets, with distinct instruction-set states and encoding choices. <bookmark mark='c'/> RISC-V provides an open ISA that can be implemented without an ISA license royalty. That does not remove every other IP, implementation or compliance cost. <bookmark mark='d'/> MIPS and other architectures also shaped processors and teaching systems. Across these families, evaluate the generated program and the specific implementation using instruction counts, timing and resource measurements, rather than treating RISC or CISC as a complete performance prediction.
54eef854d93c.zh: 指令集保护已有软件投入，具体实现则不断变化。<bookmark mark='a'/>x86 兼容范围很广，但可用性取决于执行模式、扩展和操作系统支持，并非一九七八年以来的每条指令都能在所有现代模式下原样执行。<bookmark mark='b'/>Arm 设计涵盖许多实现与市场，具有不同指令集状态和编码选择。<bookmark mark='c'/>RISC-V 是开放指令集，可以不支付指令集许可版税而实现，但不表示不存在其他知识产权、实现或合规成本。<bookmark mark='d'/>MIPS 等架构也影响了处理器和教学系统。比较这些家族时，应测量生成程序与具体实现的指令数、时序及资源，而不是把精简或复杂标签当成完整性能预测。

d8152adc94ff.en: This grid shows starts in a twenty-four-cycle sample from the offline trace scheduler, with four start slots per cycle. It is not an issue-activity recording from the functional core. <bookmark mark='a'/> Fifty-eight of its ninety-six displayed slots contain scheduled instructions. The empty cells are directly counted in this particular sample. <bookmark mark='b'/> Separately, the functional core retires about one point nine instructions per cycle. Retired IPC cannot tell us how many issue slots were used: wrong-path and replayed operations may execute without retiring. Our implementation also has a different total execution-start limit from its four-wide front end. <bookmark mark='c'/> The useful question is whether another independent thread can share resources and improve aggregate throughput, under an explicitly stated scheduling model. Neither the grid nor retired IPC measures powered idle hardware or energy consumption.
d8152adc94ff.zh: 这张格子图来自离线轨迹调度器的二十四周期片段，每周期四个启动槽，并不是功能模型核的发射活动记录。<bookmark mark='a'/>图中九十六个槽，有五十八个安排了指令，空格是这个特定片段里直接统计出来的。<bookmark mark='b'/>另一个统计是功能模型核每周期提交约一点九条指令。提交吞吐无法告诉我们用了多少发射槽，因为错误路径和重放操作可能执行却不提交。而本实现的总执行启动上限，也不同于四宽前端。<bookmark mark='c'/>有用的问题是：在明确的调度模型中，另一条独立线程能否共享资源，提高总吞吐。格子图与提交吞吐都没有测量空闲硬件是否通电，也没有测量能耗。

1200f8276653.en: Simultaneous multithreading lets operations from different threads share execution resources. Tullsen, Eggers and Levy's 1995 paper is an influential study of this approach. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here we interleave two known Job traces in an offline oracle scheduler, sharing four start slots and giving each thread its own dependency state, control barriers and half of the start-distance allowance. This is not a functionally verified SMT implementation of Pebble. <bookmark mark='b'/> Real SMT needs per-thread architectural, retirement, exception and recovery state, plus ownership information for shared queues. PCs, register mappings and branch history alone are not enough. Sharing and partitioning policies vary by design. <bookmark mark='c'/> The colored grid illustrates how one thread can use cycles where another lacks ready work. Actual fairness, cache contention, recovery and isolation require a fuller machine and workload analysis.
1200f8276653.zh: 同时多线程让不同线程的操作共享执行资源。图尔森、埃格斯和利维一九九五年的论文，是这条路线的重要研究。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里用离线先知调度器交错安排两条已知任务轨迹，共享四个启动槽，每个线程保留自己的依赖状态、控制屏障，以及一半的启动距离额度。这不是经过功能验证的 Pebble 同时多线程实现。<bookmark mark='b'/>真实同时多线程还需要每线程的体系结构、提交、异常和恢复状态，以及共享队列的归属信息。只有程序计数器、寄存器映射与分支历史远远不够，不同设计的共享和划分策略也不同。<bookmark mark='c'/>彩色格子说明一个线程如何利用另一线程缺少就绪工作的周期。实际公平性、缓存争用、恢复与隔离，都需要更完整的机器和负载分析。

d2a2a5ac6dda.en: These bars report combined throughput in the same offline scheduling study. The traces are truncated to equal instruction counts, and both must finish. <bookmark mark='a'/> With four start slots and the stated lookahead allowance, one trace averages about two point seven instructions per cycle; the two together reach about three point seven. <bookmark mark='b'/> At eight slots, the aggregate improvement is larger for these particular traces and assumptions. This is not a universal scaling rule or a measurement of a production SMT processor. <bookmark mark='c'/> Real sharing can improve aggregate throughput while slowing an individual thread, and results depend on workload, partitioning and contention. Fairness, latency, energy and security are separate evaluation axes. Timing interactions between threads can also expose information, so throughput alone is not a complete design objective.
d2a2a5ac6dda.zh: 柱状图报告同一个离线调度研究中的合计吞吐。两条轨迹被截成相同指令数，并且都必须完成。<bookmark mark='a'/>采用四个启动槽和已说明的向前查看额度时，一条轨迹平均每周期约二点七条指令，两条合计约三点七。<bookmark mark='b'/>八个槽时，这些特定轨迹与假设下的合计增益更大。这不是通用扩展规律，也不是量产同时多线程处理器的测量。<bookmark mark='c'/>真实共享可能提高总吞吐，同时拖慢单条线程，结果取决于负载、划分与争用。公平性、延迟、能耗和安全是不同评估维度，线程间计时交互也可能暴露信息，所以吞吐不是完整的设计目标。

ac884872debf.en: These five instructions illustrate register dependencies and name hazards. <bookmark mark='a'/> The first load produces the value used by the following add. Without value prediction, that add must wait for its actual input: a read-after-write dependence. <bookmark mark='b'/> The second load reuses a0. If all versions shared one storage location, it must not overwrite the old value before the earlier add reads it: a write-after-read hazard. <bookmark mark='c'/> The two loads also reuse the destination name, creating a write-after-write hazard in such an organization. <bookmark mark='d'/> Those last hazards arise from storage-name reuse, not a value passing between the operations. Separate live versions remove them. The genuine producer-consumer chains, and any memory, control or resource constraints, still have to be respected.
ac884872debf.zh: 这五条指令说明寄存器数据依赖与名称冒险。<bookmark mark='a'/>第一次取数产生随后加法使用的值。不采用值预测时，加法必须等待实际输入，这就是写后读依赖。<bookmark mark='b'/>第二次取数重用 a0。如果所有版本共享一个存储位置，就不能在先前加法读取旧值之前覆盖它，这就是读后写冒险。<bookmark mark='c'/>两次取数也重用目标名称，在这种组织中造成写后写冒险。<bookmark mark='d'/>后两种冒险来自存储名称重用，不是操作之间传递了值。分开存活版本就能消除它们，但真正的产生者与使用者链，以及内存、控制或资源约束仍必须遵守。

8573dffc90f5.en: These are reported retirement-tracking capacities in a historical selection of cores from 1995 through 2024. The entries do not all count the same thing: architectural instructions, micro-operations and fused operations must be distinguished. <bookmark mark='a'/> The early examples include Pentium Pro, MIPS R10000 and Alpha 21264. <bookmark mark='b'/> Later examples include Core 2, Sandy Bridge, Haswell, Skylake and Zen. Their capacities increased as implementations changed, but capacity alone does not predict workload performance. <bookmark mark='c'/> Sunny Cove, Golden Cove, Zen 4 and Zen 5 extend this historical sample. Apple Firestorm is shown separately: Dougall Johnson's reverse-engineered notes describe about three hundred thirty coalesced retire groups and six hundred twenty-three rename-retire entries. A single six-hundred-thirty-instruction ROB dot would hide that distinction. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our model tracks a hundred twenty-eight architectural instructions and is never full on this chapter; its entries are not directly interchangeable with every hardware entry on the plot.
8573dffc90f5.zh: 图中选取一九九五至二零二四年的历史处理器，展示公开报告的提交跟踪容量。表项计算的对象并不完全相同，需要区分体系结构指令、微操作和融合操作。<bookmark mark='a'/>早期例子包括 Pentium Pro、MIPS R10000 与 Alpha 21264。<bookmark mark='b'/>之后有 Core 2、Sandy Bridge、Haswell、Skylake 和 Zen。容量随着实现变化而增加，但仅凭容量不能预测负载性能。<bookmark mark='c'/>Sunny Cove、Golden Cove、Zen 4 与 Zen 5 延伸了这组历史样本。苹果 Firestorm 单独说明：道格尔·约翰逊的逆向测量笔记描述约三百三十个合并提交组，以及六百二十三个重命名提交表项。把它画成一个六百三十条指令的重排序点，会掩盖这种区别。<bookmark mark='d'/>本模型跟踪一百二十八条体系结构指令，在这一章从未占满，但它的表项不能与图中所有硬件表项直接互换。

174886e74868.en: Larger windows can expose independent work while a long-latency operation waits. <bookmark mark='a'/> As an illustration, a memory access lasting three hundred core cycles represents twelve hundred potential start opportunities at four per cycle. Whether they exist and can be reached depends on dependencies, prediction and resources; DRAM latency in cycles also depends on the clock and memory system. <bookmark mark='b'/> Branch accuracy varies with workload, predictor and measurement definition. A few misses per thousand instructions is not a universal property of typical code. <bookmark mark='c'/> Fetch, decode, dispatch, issue and retirement widths must be specified separately. Encoding, fusion and instruction mix change the operations counted at each stage. <bookmark mark='d'/> Larger tracking and selection structures cost area and energy. Banking, clustering, gating and other implementation choices change those costs. This discussion does not measure which structure is hottest or establish one universal best window size.
174886e74868.zh: 长延迟操作等待时，更大窗口可能发现独立工作。<bookmark mark='a'/>例如一次内存访问若持续三百个核周期，每周期四次启动就对应一千二百个潜在机会。但这些工作是否存在、能否到达，取决于依赖、预测和资源；以周期计的动态内存延迟也取决于时钟与存储系统。<bookmark mark='b'/>分支准确率随负载、预测器与统计定义而变，每千条指令只错几次，并不是所谓典型代码的通用性质。<bookmark mark='c'/>取指、译码、派发、发射与提交宽度必须分别说明。编码、融合与指令组合会改变各阶段统计的操作数量。<bookmark mark='d'/>更大的跟踪和选择结构需要面积与能量，分组、聚类、门控等实现选择会改变成本。这里没有测量哪个结构最热，也没有确定一个通用最佳窗口大小。

106ca1227065.en: Check numbers against the source and the exact core model. <bookmark mark='a'/> Vendor manuals describe supported architectures and implementation guidance. Agner Fog's guide and independent measurements cover many designs. The uops.info project reports measured instruction properties for most instructions on many recent x86 microarchitectures, not every instruction on every processor. Reverse-engineered capacities should be labeled as estimates and their counted structures identified. <bookmark mark='b'/> Linux perf can expose supported performance events when hardware, kernel configuration and permissions allow. Events and definitions differ across vendors and models. Counters can test selected performance hypotheses, but they do not reveal every internal state shown by this simulator.
106ca1227065.zh: 核对数字时，要检查来源与准确的核型号。<bookmark mark='a'/>厂商手册提供支持架构和实现指南，阿格纳·福格的指南与独立测量覆盖许多设计。uops.info 为许多较新的 x86 微架构报告大多数指令的实测性质，并非覆盖每台处理器上的每条指令。逆向得到的容量应标成估计，并明确统计的是哪一种结构。<bookmark mark='b'/>硬件、内核配置和权限允许时，Linux perf 可以读取支持的性能事件。事件及定义随厂商和型号变化。计数器能检验部分性能假设，但无法展示模拟器中可见的每一项内部状态。

4065a63d6f7a.en: This stack is an accounting comparison, not a unique causal decomposition. <bookmark mark='a'/> Four-wide architectural retirement gives an ideal lower floor of one quarter cycle per retired instruction. It is not the total execution-start limit. <bookmark mark='b'/> The oracle-assisted run uses about zero point three one seven cycles per instruction; its gap above that floor includes the model's dependency, front-end and resource constraints. <bookmark mark='c'/> The tournament run uses about zero point five two nine. Their difference is a configuration gap, not a separately measured amount of time spent only on branches. <bookmark mark='d'/> Part 7's pipeline is another configuration, with about one point two cycles per instruction. <bookmark mark='e'/> The oracle-assisted core uses about forty percent fewer cycles than the tournament core on this chapter, with interactions among prediction, queues and memory recovery. The length test is important in the measured trace, but these comparisons do not prove its outcomes are unlearnable or assign every saved cycle to it.
4065a63d6f7a.zh: 这组堆叠图是记账式对比，不是唯一的因果分解。<bookmark mark='a'/>体系结构每周期最多提交四条指令，对应每条提交指令四分之一周期的理想下限，并不是总执行启动上限。<bookmark mark='b'/>先知辅助运行每条指令约用零点三一七周期，高于下限的差距包含模型的数据依赖、前端与资源约束。<bookmark mark='c'/>锦标赛运行约为零点五二九，两者之差是配置差距，不是单独测出的纯分支耗时。<bookmark mark='d'/>第七部分流水线是另一配置，每条指令约一点二周期。<bookmark mark='e'/>本章先知辅助核比锦标赛核少用约百分之四十周期，其中包含预测、队列和内存恢复之间的相互作用。长度检查在记录轨迹中很重要，但这些对比没有证明其结果无法学习，也不能把每个节省周期都归给它。

f529f4885c09.en: A full cycle-by-cycle simulation of the corpus is expensive, so use a fitted projection and expose its limits. <bookmark mark='a'/> The training set contains twenty-four randomly selected text slices, four hundred to four thousand characters long. The actual inputs and byte-count features are UTF-8 encoded; the slice length metadata is not always the encoded byte length. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fit model cycles as a linear function of text features, including word counts, scanned entries and letter comparisons. <bookmark mark='c'/> One separate Moby-Dick slice has sixteen thousand characters and sixteen thousand nineteen encoded bytes. It takes about three point two nine million simulated cycles, and this fit predicts it within about zero point zero nine percent. That is one heldout check, not a full-corpus error bound or evidence that all unseen texts behave equally well. Host simulation speed also depends on machine and configuration.
f529f4885c09.zh: 逐周期模拟全部语料成本较高，因此采用拟合预测，并明确它的限制。<bookmark mark='a'/>训练集包含随机选择的二十四个文本片段，每段四百到四千字符。实际输入和字节数特征采用 UTF-8 编码，片段长度元数据不一定等于编码字节数。<bookmark mark='b'/>用文本特征线性拟合模型周期，包括单词数、扫描条目与字母比较等。<bookmark mark='c'/>另一个《白鲸》片段有一万六千字符，编码后是一万六千零一十九字节。它需要约三百二十九万个模拟周期，拟合预测的误差约为百分之零点零九。这只有一个留出检查，不是全语料误差上界，也不能证明所有未见文本都一样准确。宿主模拟速度还取决于机器与配置。

f29650729894.en: Apply the fitted cycle model to the corpus's counted text features. <bookmark mark='a'/> It projects about fifty point seven billion cycles for about a hundred six point nine billion architectural instructions, an average IPC near two point one. Those corpus cycles were not obtained by running every instruction through this core. <bookmark mark='b'/> Converting them to time additionally assumes Part 7's teaching clock budget, about eight hundred eighty-five megahertz. This out-of-order design has no gate-level timing result establishing that frequency. The projected runtime is about fifty-seven seconds. <bookmark mark='c'/> At the shared assumed clock, the previous fitted pipeline row is about two and a half times slower. Both the cycle extrapolation and frequency assumptions travel with that ratio. The ledger is a transparent model comparison, not a measured complete-corpus hardware benchmark.
f29650729894.zh: 把拟合周期模型应用到语料统计出的文本特征。<bookmark mark='a'/>约一千零六十九亿条体系结构指令，预测需要约五百零七亿周期，平均每周期约二点一条。全语料周期并不是让每条指令都在这个核上运行得到的。<bookmark mark='b'/>把周期换成时间，还须采用第七部分的教学时钟预算，约八百八十五兆赫。这个乱序设计并没有门级时序结果来确定该频率，预测运行时间约五十七秒。<bookmark mark='c'/>在共同假定时钟下，前一项拟合流水线时间约慢二点五倍。比值同时带有周期外推与频率假设。账本提供透明的模型比较，不是完整语料的实测硬件基准。

99f68fba3c12.en: Value prediction changes the dependency model by guessing a load's result before it is verified. <bookmark mark='a'/> Dependents can tentatively use a predicted value, then correctness requires validation and recovery if it was wrong. This can pass a dependency bound derived for waiting on actual values because the assumptions changed. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here a per-load-PC stride predictor learns from the recorded trace, with a confidence threshold. It is an offline scheduling study, including trace-supplied inputs, not an implemented functional value-predicting core. <bookmark mark='c'/> At eight start slots, the no-value-prediction baseline is about three point three four IPC; an oracle that guesses every load correctly reaches about three point nine eight under the other retained assumptions. <bookmark mark='d'/> The real heuristic predicts only a subset and makes mistakes, so its schedules are slower than the baseline at the shown thresholds. Correctness, coverage, prediction availability, I/O ordering and recovery cost must all be addressed before translating this exercise into hardware.
