99f68fba3c12.zh: 值预测在验证之前猜取数结果，因此改变了数据依赖模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>依赖者可以暂时使用预测值，但正确性要求之后验证，猜错时恢复。它可以越过“必须等待实际值”这一假设下的依赖界限，因为假设已经改变。<bookmark mark='b'/>这里按取数指令位置建立步长预测器，从记录轨迹学习，并使用置信阈值。这是包含轨迹预先提供输入的离线调度研究，不是已实现的功能性值预测核。<bookmark mark='c'/>八个启动槽时，不作值预测的基线约为每周期三点三四条；保留其他假设、每次都猜对取数的先知约为三点九八。<bookmark mark='d'/>实际启发式只预测一部分，而且会出错，因此图中各阈值下都比基线慢。要把练习转成硬件，必须处理正确性、覆盖率、预测何时可用、输入输出顺序与恢复成本。

f176c31ce715.en: Accuracy alone does not determine whether value prediction pays. <bookmark mark='a'/> Benefit depends on which loads are covered, when predictions arrive, how much dependent work they unlock, and the cost of validation and mistakes. There is no universal ninety-nine-percent threshold. <bookmark mark='b'/> High-confidence value-prediction work, including Perais and Seznec's 2014 research, studies particular mechanisms and recovery choices. Our simple scheduler is not a reproduction of those designs. <bookmark mark='c'/> In the shown eight-slot configuration, perfect load guesses improve this trace schedule by about nineteen percent, while the simple stride heuristic loses performance. Both statements are conditional on the rest of the scheduler's assumptions, including its prediction barriers and idealized memory information. <bookmark mark='d'/> A useful research question is which workload, coverage and recovery policy produces net benefit under a realistic functional model.
f176c31ce715.zh: 仅有准确率不能决定值预测是否值得。<bookmark mark='a'/>收益取决于覆盖哪些取数、预测何时到达、能解锁多少依赖工作，以及验证与猜错成本，不存在通用的百分之九十九门槛。<bookmark mark='b'/>包括佩赖斯与塞兹内克二零一四年研究在内的高置信值预测工作，讨论具体机制与恢复选择，本简化调度器不是那些设计的复现。<bookmark mark='c'/>图中的八槽配置里，完美猜取数能把这条轨迹调度提高约百分之十九，简单步长启发式反而变慢。两项结论都依赖调度器其余假设，包括预测屏障与理想化内存信息。<bookmark mark='d'/>有用的研究问题是：在现实的功能模型下，哪些负载、覆盖率和恢复策略能带来净收益。

447c7b549ade.en: Our optional rule delays broadcasting a completed load's value while an older branch or indirect jump remains unresolved. <bookmark mark='a'/> That prevents dependent operations from using that value during the unresolved control speculation in this model. It is inspired by information-flow defenses, but does not implement complete STT or NDA algorithms. <bookmark mark='b'/> In the supplied Spectre experiment, the tested nonzero probe lines no longer reveal PEBBLE. This is a finite gadget result, not a proof of noninterference for every program or channel. <bookmark mark='c'/> On the Job chapter, model cycles increase from four hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred eighty to four hundred fifty-three thousand one hundred twelve, about three point five percent. That cost is specific to this trace and implementation. <bookmark mark='d'/> Fault speculation, memory-alias speculation, preexisting register secrets, stores and other channels require separate analysis. We must state the attacker, permitted observations and protected data before making a security guarantee.
447c7b549ade.zh: 可选规则会在较老分支或间接跳转尚未解决时，延迟广播已完成取数的值。<bookmark mark='a'/>这样在模型中的未解决控制推测期间，依赖操作无法使用该值。它受信息流防御启发，但没有实现完整的 STT 或 NDA 算法。<bookmark mark='b'/>在给定幽灵实验中，已测试的非零探测行不再泄漏 PEBBLE。这是有限片段的结果，不是对所有程序或通道的无干扰证明。<bookmark mark='c'/>任务这一章的模型周期从四十三万七千五百八十增加到四十五万三千一百一十二，约慢百分之三点五，成本仅对应这条轨迹和实现。<bookmark mark='d'/>故障推测、内存别名推测、寄存器中已有秘密、存数及其他通道都需要分别分析。作出安全保证前，必须先说明攻击者、允许观察的内容与要保护的数据。

d17e38d7bc4d.en: Secure speculation is an active research area with formal results under explicit models. <bookmark mark='a'/> ProSpeCT, published in 2023, gives a formal processor model and a constant-time-policy security proof, plus a RISC-V hardware prototype. Its theorem has specified program and observation assumptions; it is not a proof that arbitrary physical systems have no side channels. <bookmark mark='b'/> Dolma's 2021 transient-non-observability design examines broader data sources and store-related attacks, with overheads measured on its chosen workloads and threat models. Such papers show why a successful gadget test is weaker than a stated security theorem. <bookmark mark='c'/> Compare like observations, attacker powers, protected inputs and baseline behavior before comparing guarantees or costs. There is no single minimum security overhead without those definitions. <bookmark mark='d'/> Likewise, the earlier oracle IPC is a trace-and-assumption result, not an implementation target guaranteed by a universal parallelism theorem. Good research turns an explicit model into a precise claim, then tests where that claim stops applying.
d17e38d7bc4d.zh: 安全推测是活跃研究领域，已经在明确模型下取得形式化结果。<bookmark mark='a'/>二零二三年的 ProSpeCT 提供形式化处理器模型、针对常数时间策略的安全证明，以及 RISC-V 硬件原型。定理具有特定的程序与观察假设，并不是说任意物理系统都没有侧信道。<bookmark mark='b'/>二零二一年的 Dolma 通过瞬态不可观察性研究更广的数据来源与存数相关攻击，并在选定负载和威胁模型下测量开销。这些论文说明，成功通过一个片段测试，远弱于陈述清楚的安全定理。<bookmark mark='c'/>比较保证和成本前，先对齐观察内容、攻击者能力、受保护输入与基线行为。没有这些定义，就不存在单一的最低安全开销。<bookmark mark='d'/>同样，先前的先知吞吐取决于轨迹与假设，不是通用并行定理保证能实现的目标。好的研究先把明确模型变成精确结论，再检验结论适用到哪里。

837e318cf736.en: This part connected dependency graphs to scheduling under stated latencies and resources, then separated register-name hazards from real value dependencies. We followed scoreboards, producer tags and precise architectural retirement, and checked a functional out-of-order model against the emulator on finite tests. Trace-oracle studies exposed the importance of their own knowledge, resource and ordering assumptions. A simulated Spectre gadget showed that squashed architectural work can leave observable cache effects, while two mitigations stopped that supplied witness under the model's rules. Finally, passage simulations supported a fitted full-corpus ledger projection at an assumed clock. Each conclusion travels with that evidence and scope.
837e318cf736.zh: 本部分把依赖图与明确延迟和资源条件下的调度连接起来，区分寄存器名称冒险和真正的值依赖。我们研究记分牌、产生者标签与精确体系结构提交，并通过有限测试把功能乱序模型与指令模拟器对照。轨迹先知研究说明，它们自己的知识、资源与顺序假设非常关键。模拟幽灵片段展示了被清除的体系结构工作如何留下可观察缓存效果，两种缓解方法在模型规则下阻止了给定例证。最后，根据片段模拟，在假定时钟下拟合全语料账本预测。每个结论都应带着相应证据与适用范围。

c14c521a3692.en: These ideas return in several later parts. Larger windows interact with cache misses and memory-level parallelism in Part 9. Width, energy and multiple cores interact in Part 10. Static scheduling and software pipelining return with compiler transformations. The Job's repeated length checks motivate different data structures and algorithms; a measured predictor's difficulty does not prove a branch unlearnable. Reordering loads and stores connects to concurrency and memory models, where single-thread correctness and inter-thread visibility are different questions. The simulated security example leads into threat models and operating-system defenses, and static scheduling reappears in specialized hardware. The common habit is to connect a mechanism to a measured workload and explicit assumptions.
c14c521a3692.zh: 这些想法会在后面的课程再次出现。第九部分讨论大窗口与缓存缺失、内存级并行的关系，第十部分连接宽度、能量和多核。静态调度与软件流水会在编译器变换中回来。任务反复检查长度，也会引出不同数据结构和算法；某个已测预测器觉得困难，不代表分支无法学习。取数与存数重排连接并发和内存模型，单线程正确性与线程间可见性是不同问题。模拟安全例子通向威胁模型和操作系统防御，静态调度也会在专用硬件中重现。共同习惯是把机制与实测负载、明确假设联系起来。

5cff4afc34aa.en: In practice, use implementation manuals and measurements together. Linux perf and top-down analysis expose supported event categories when hardware and permissions allow, but event meanings differ across cores. Production processors combine related scheduling ideas with many details omitted by Pebble. BOOM and other open designs let you inspect an implementation, while gem5 and trace simulators answer different modeling questions. Compiler and kernel hardening can mitigate particular speculative attacks under specified conditions; their names are not blanket security guarantees. When a counter, simulator or diagram supports a claim, state what it measures and what assumptions connect that measurement to the question.
5cff4afc34aa.zh: 实践中，要把实现手册与测量结合起来。硬件和权限允许时，Linux perf 与自顶向下分析能展示支持的事件类别，但事件含义随处理器核变化。量产处理器把相关调度思想与 Pebble 省略的大量细节结合起来。BOOM 等开放设计便于查看具体实现，gem5 和轨迹模拟器则回答不同的建模问题。编译器与内核加固能在规定条件下缓解特定推测攻击，但名称不是包罗一切的安全保证。用计数器、模拟器或图支持结论时，要说明它测量什么，以及哪些假设把测量与问题联系起来。

1cb41a09beb4.en: The exercises ask you to build dependency schedules, distinguish instruction-count start limits from weighted processing-work bounds, and rename live register versions. Treat the CPI penalty calculation as a defined accounting model rather than a universal causal law. Before hoisting a load, prove its address and exception safety. For the research exercise, define protected data, public inputs, permitted observations and a non-speculative baseline, then search for a counterexample to our control-shadow rule. A finite successful test and a general security proof are different deliverables.
1cb41a09beb4.zh: 习题要求构造依赖调度，区分指令数决定的启动下界与带权处理工作量的界限，并为存活寄存器版本重命名。每指令周期代价计算应视作明确的记账模型，而非普遍因果定律。提前取数前，先证明地址与异常安全。研究题先定义受保护数据、公开输入、允许观察内容与非推测基线，再寻找控制阴影规则的反例。有限测试成功与一般安全证明，是不同的交付结果。

d697630b05bf.en: Next, the memory hierarchy. Part 7 assigned illustrative memory delays; physical DRAM latency in core cycles depends on clock, configuration and access pattern. Part 9 studies caches, locality and the Job's miss-rate curves, and measures a latency staircase on this host. It also develops data-movement bounds for classical matrix multiplication under a specified computation model and limited fast memory. Those assumptions matter: a bound for one algorithmic model is not automatically a theorem about every possible matrix multiplication algorithm.
d697630b05bf.zh: 下一部分是存储层次。第七部分指定了示意内存延迟，物理动态内存以核周期计的延迟，则取决于时钟、配置与访问模式。第九部分研究缓存、局部性和任务缺失率曲线，并在这台宿主机上测量延迟阶梯。还会在规定计算模型与有限快速内存条件下，推导经典矩阵乘法的数据移动界限。假设很重要：某种算法模型的界限，并不会自动成为关于所有矩阵乘法算法的定理。

1a64a4bdaec7.en: These four functional-core runs differ in prediction policy. <bookmark mark='a'/> Always-taken prediction gives about zero point six nine retired instructions per cycle. <bookmark mark='b'/> Two-bit and tournament prediction give about one point eight seven and one point eight nine. <bookmark mark='c'/> The oracle-assisted setting gives about three point one six. It knows correct-path outcomes, yet this implementation still records two redirects and one memory-order violation, so its label must not imply zero recovery events. <bookmark mark='d'/> In the tournament run, the model counts twenty-two thousand two hundred ninety-six branch redirects and two hundred fifty-three thousand seven hundred sixty-four squashed renamed entries. That is about thirty-one percent of the retired count, not thirty-one percent extra executed instructions. Some entries never issued. Separately, twenty-eight thousand nine hundred five loads execute on wrong paths in the modeled memory system.
1a64a4bdaec7.zh: 这四次功能模型运行采用不同预测策略。<bookmark mark='a'/>总是预测跳转时，平均每周期提交约零点六九条指令。<bookmark mark='b'/>两位计数器与锦标赛分别约为一点八七和一点八九。<bookmark mark='c'/>先知辅助配置约为三点一六。它知道正确路径结果，但本实现仍记录了两次重定向和一次内存顺序违例，所以标签不能暗示完全没有恢复事件。<bookmark mark='d'/>锦标赛运行记录了两万二千二百九十六次分支重定向，以及二十五万三千七百六十四个被清除的已重命名表项，约为提交数量的百分之三十一。这不是额外执行了百分之三十一的指令，因为有些表项根本没有发射。另外，模型内存系统中有二万八千九百零五次错误路径取数确实执行。
